# Schema reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the Zod schemas (`engine/core/content/manifest.ts`, `engine/tools/run-file.ts`, `engine/sim/save.ts`, `engine/sim/scenario.ts`, `engine/sim/timeline.ts`, `engine/tools/dump-file.ts`, `engine/sim/carry.ts`, `engine/core/campaign.ts`, each content kind) and `docs/reference/examples/`. Do not edit by hand: `pnpm docs:check` (part of `pnpm test`) fails when this page is out of date. -->

One section per file format. Each table lists every field: nested fields are written under their
parent (`input.steps[].frame` is a field of each item of `input.steps`; `<key>` is any key of a map).
"Required" is whether the file must give it; a field with a default may be left out. Checks beyond
the shape (a room's map must parse, a song's MML must compile) are listed in the kind's module
page. `pnpm cli validate <game>` checks every file; errors name the file and the field.

## Game manifest (`game.json`)

Names the game and its kit, the files of each content kind, the start seed and the game's entry modules.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `games/<game>/game.json`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                       | Type                                                                                                                 | Required | Default                      | Limits                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                        | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the game's id: its folder name                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `title`                     | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | one line saying what the game is                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `kit`                       | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the kit the game is built on (a folder under `kits/`)                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `uses`                      | `string[]`                                                                                                           | no       |                              | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | more kits whose content kinds the game also holds (e.g. a mini game's rooms); kinds only: run rules and mutants stay `kit`'s                                                                                                                    |
| `kitOptions`                | `{ <key>: { <key>: any } }`                                                                                          | no       |                              | keys: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                   | options for the game's kits, by kit name (`kit` or one in `uses`): each kit's own fields, such as the topdown kit's `rooms`; a kit checks its own                                                                                               |
| `content`                   | `{ <key>: string[] }`                                                                                                | yes      |                              | keys: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                   | content kind -> its files; every file under `content/` must be claimed by one kind                                                                                                                                                              |
| `content.<key>`             | `string[]`                                                                                                           | no       |                              | at least 1 item; items: not empty                      | file paths or globs (`*`, `?`, `**`), relative to the game folder                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `start`                     | `object`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              |                                                        | how a run starts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `start.seed`                | `integer`                                                                                                            | yes      |                              | >= 0                                                   | the seed for the world's RNG when nothing else gives one                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `screen`                    | `object`                                                                                                             | no       | `{"width":256,"height":240}` |                                                        | the game picture's size in game px (default 256x240); scaling, the touch layout and screenshots follow it                                                                                                                                       |
| `screen.width`              | `integer`                                                                                                            | yes      |                              | 64 to 1920                                             | the picture width in game px                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `screen.height`             | `integer`                                                                                                            | yes      |                              | 64 to 1920                                             | the picture height in game px                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `transitions`               | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | screen transitions the browser shell plays, by slot (`level`, `scene`, `mission`, `default`): `{ kind: fade \| wipe \| iris, ticks, hold?, color?, ease? }` (Engine 0.16 T5)                                                                    |
| `transitions.level`         | `object \| object \| object`                                                                                         | no       |                              |                                                        | played when the map id changes (the next level)                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `transitions.scene`         | `object \| object \| object`                                                                                         | no       |                              |                                                        | played when a scene is pushed or popped (a round)                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `transitions.mission`       | `object \| object \| object`                                                                                         | no       |                              |                                                        | played when a mission round is pushed or popped (else `scene`)                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `transitions.default`       | `object \| object \| object`                                                                                         | no       |                              |                                                        | played when the slot asked for gives none                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `menus`                     | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | the title screen, pause menu, settings and controls screens the browser shell builds (Engine 0.16 T9): `{ font, titleFont?, style?, labels?, title: { name \| logo, subtitle?, art?, music?, items }, pause: { items }, settings?, controls? }` |
| `menus.font`                | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | the font file menu text is drawn in                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `menus.titleFont`           | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | the font of the title name and headings (default `font`)                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `menus.style`               | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | the menus look: UI style fields (colours, panel, cursor, sounds, tweens) and `heading`, `outline`, `dim`                                                                                                                                        |
| `menus.style.text`          | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | text colour (default `#fcfcfc`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `menus.style.shadow`        | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | a one-px drop shadow under text                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `menus.style.focusText`     | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | the focused item's text (default `#f8b800`)                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `menus.style.disabledText`  | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | a disabled item's text (default `#7c7c7c`)                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `menus.style.back`          | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | a panel's fill without a frame (default `#000000`)                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `menus.style.focusBack`     | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | the bar behind the focused item (default `#24188c`)                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `menus.style.border`        | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | a frameless panel's one-px border (default `#fcfcfc`)                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.style.track`         | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | a slider's empty track (default `#3c3c3c`)                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `menus.style.fill`          | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | a slider's fill and a toggle's on box (default `#00a800`)                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `menus.style.panel`         | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | the nine-slice frame panels, menus and dialogs are drawn in                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `menus.style.panel.sheet`   | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | a sprite file of the game                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `menus.style.panel.frame`   | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | a frame of that sheet                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.style.panel.palette` | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a palette file to recolour it with                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `menus.style.panel.slice`   | `integer \| object`                                                                                                  | yes      |                              |                                                        | the corner insets in px: one number or `{ left, top, right, bottom }`                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.style.cursor`        | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty; length &lt;= 1                              | a character drawn left of the focused item (`>`)                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `menus.style.padding`       | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              | >= 0                                                   | px inside a panel (default 4)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `menus.style.gap`           | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              | >= 0                                                   | px between menu items (default 2)                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `menus.style.rate`          | `number`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | >= 0                                                   | display frames per character a dialog types (default 2; 0 shows a page at once)                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `menus.style.typeEvery`     | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              | >= 1                                                   | characters per `type` sound (default 3)                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `menus.style.sounds`        | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | sfx ids played by the shell on UI events (each optional)                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `menus.style.sounds.move`   | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | focus moved or a value changed                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `menus.style.sounds.select` | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | an item or a choice taken                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `menus.style.sounds.back`   | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | back out of a widget                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `menus.style.sounds.type`   | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a dialog typing (every `typeEvery` characters)                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `menus.style.sounds.page`   | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a dialog turning to its next page                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `menus.style.focusTween`    | `object \| object \| (object \| object)[]`                                                                           | no       |                              |                                                        | played on an item when it takes the focus (T1 tween specs)                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `menus.style.pressTween`    | `object \| object \| (object \| object)[]`                                                                           | no       |                              |                                                        | played on an item when it is pressed                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `menus.style.heading`       | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | headings and the title name (default `focusText`)                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `menus.style.outline`       | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | the outline round headings and the name (default `#000000`)                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `menus.style.dim`           | `number`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | 0 to 1                                                 | how dark the dim over the game is (0.55)                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `menus.style.dimColor`      | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`        | the dim's colour (`#000000`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `menus.labels`              | `{ <key>: string }`                                                                                                  | no       |                              |                                                        | item id -> its label, replacing the default (`{ "start": "New game" }`)                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `menus.title`               | `object`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              |                                                        | the title screen                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `menus.title.name`          | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | the game's name, drawn in the title font                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `menus.title.logo`          | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | a sprite frame drawn instead of the name                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `menus.title.logo.sheet`    | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | a sprite file of the game                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `menus.title.logo.frame`    | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | a frame of that sheet                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.title.logo.palette`  | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a palette file to recolour it with                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `menus.title.logo.scale`    | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              | 1 to 8                                                 | whole-number scale (1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `menus.title.subtitle`      | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | one line under the name                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `menus.title.art`           | `object[]`                                                                                                           | no       |                              |                                                        | more sprite frames drawn on the title                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.title.art[].sheet`   | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | a sprite file of the game                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `menus.title.art[].frame`   | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | a frame of that sheet                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.title.art[].palette` | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a palette file to recolour it with                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `menus.title.art[].scale`   | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              | 1 to 8                                                 | whole-number scale (1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `menus.title.art[].anchor`  | `"top-left" \| "top" \| "top-right" \| "left" \| "center" \| "right" \| "bottom-left" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-right"` | no       |                              |                                                        | where it sits (default `center`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `menus.title.art[].x`       | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              |                                                        | px inward from the anchor (0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `menus.title.art[].y`       | `integer`                                                                                                            | no       |                              |                                                        | px inward from the anchor (0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `menus.title.dim`           | `number`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | 0 to 1                                                 | how dark the dim over the game's start picture is (default the style's)                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `menus.title.music`         | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a song (or layered music entry) played on the title                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `menus.title.footer`        | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | a small line at the bottom (credits, a version)                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `menus.title.items`         | `string[]`                                                                                                           | yes      |                              | at least 1 item                                        | the title menu: start, continue, controls, settings                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `menus.pause`               | `object`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              |                                                        | the pause menu (Escape, P, gamepad Start or the on-screen button)                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `menus.pause.items`         | `string[]`                                                                                                           | yes      |                              | at least 1 item                                        | the pause menu: resume, controls, settings, title                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `menus.settings`            | `object`                                                                                                             | no       |                              |                                                        | the settings screen                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `menus.settings.items`      | `string[]`                                                                                                           | yes      |                              | at least 1 item                                        | the settings screen: master, music, sfx, mute, shake, flashing, colour, touch (default all but colour)                                                                                                                                          |
| `menus.controls`            | `object[]`                                                                                                           | no       |                              | at least 1 item                                        | the controls screen's rows: actions with what they do, shown with the player's keys                                                                                                                                                             |
| `menus.controls[].actions`  | `("left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down" \| "jump" \| "attack" \| "special" \| "start" \| "select" \| "run")[]`         | no       |                              | at least 1 item                                        | the engine actions it uses (`left`, `jump`, ...); shown with the player's keys                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `menus.controls[].label`    | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | what they do ("Jump")                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `menus.controls[].tap`      | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | the touch or mouse part ("tap a cell", "drag")                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `headless`                  | `string`                                                                                                             | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | the module that boots the game headless (`createGame`), for `run`                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `view`                      | `string`                                                                                                             | no       |                              | not empty                                              | the module that boots the game for drawing (`createView`), for `screenshot`; optional                                                                                                                                                           |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/manifest.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "one-room",
  "title": "A one-room game on the top-down kit",
  "kit": "topdown",
  "content": {
    "room": ["content/rooms/*.json"],
    "song": ["content/songs/*.json"],
    "palette": ["content/palettes/*.json"],
    "sprite": ["content/sprites/*.txt"]
  },
  "start": { "seed": 1 },
  "screen": { "width": 256, "height": 240 },
  "headless": "headless.ts",
  "view": "view.ts"
}
```

## Run file (`*.run.json`)

A seeded, scripted headless run and the checks it must pass (`pnpm cli run`).

- Defined by: engine/tools
- Where: `games/<game>/runs/<name>.run.json`; replay files in `.ww-out/replays/`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                            | Type                                                                                                         | Required | Default        | Limits                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `game`                           | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty                           | the game folder, relative to the run file (".." for games/&lt;g>/runs/); give this or `world`                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `world`                          | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty; matches `\.world\.json$` | a world scenario (*.world.json, engine/sim), relative to the run file, played instead of a game; give this or `game`                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `seed`                           | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       |                | >= 0                                | the world's seed; the manifest's start.seed (or the scenario's seed) if left out; with `from`, the save's seed, and another is a `seed_mismatch` error                                                                                                                                                                |
| `ticks`                          | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | 1 to 1000000                        | how many steps the run plays                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `input`                          | `object`                                                                                                     | no       | `{"steps":[]}` |                                     | the scripted input (ScriptedInput steps)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `input.steps`                    | `object[]`                                                                                                   | yes      |                |                                     | each step holds its actions from its frame until the next step                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `input.steps[].frame`            | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the input frame the hold starts at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `input.steps[].hold`             | `("left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down" \| "jump" \| "attack" \| "special" \| "start" \| "select" \| "run")[]` | yes      |                |                                     | the actions held from that frame on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `input.taps`                     | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | pointer taps (Engine 0.15, gap D1): each on its frame, in file order within a frame; a kit that reads taps (the tower-defense kit) plays them, others ignore them                                                                                                                                                     |
| `input.taps[].frame`             | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the input frame the tap is on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `input.taps[].x`                 | `number`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | where it lands: game screen pixels (the manifest's screen size)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `input.taps[].y`                 | `number`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | where it lands: game screen pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `input.taps[].button`            | `"primary" \| "secondary"`                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | `primary` (a left click or tap; the default) or `secondary` (a right click or long-press)                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `assertions`                     | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | checks made at one tick each                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `assertions[].tick`              | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the check is made at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `assertions[].path`              | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | a dotted path into the snapshot: hero.hp, entities.0.kind, entities.length                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `assertions[].op`                | `"eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "in" \| "nin" \| "contains"`                              | yes      |                |                                     | the comparison: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, contains                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `assertions[].value`             | `JSON`                                                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | what the value at the path is compared with                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `invariants`                     | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | checks made at every tick, 0 included                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `invariants[].path`              | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | a dotted path into the snapshot: hero.hp, entities.0.kind, entities.length                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `invariants[].op`                | `"eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "in" \| "nin" \| "contains"`                              | yes      |                |                                     | the comparison: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, contains                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `invariants[].value`             | `JSON`                                                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | what the value at the path is compared with                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `hashEvery`                      | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       | `60`           | >= 1                                | a state hash every this many ticks (tick 0 and the last tick always get one)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `disableRules`                   | `string[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           | items: not empty                    | kit rules switched off for this run (ids from the kit's rule list; `kit:id` for a kit the game `uses`; see `mutants`)                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `guards`                         | `string[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                | items: not empty                    | the kit rules this run is meant to guard (ids from the kit's rule list; `kit:id` for a kit the game `uses`); `mutants` checks these, or every rule of the game's kit when left out                                                                                                                                    |
| `orders`                         | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | recorded orders, `{ tick, ...order }` in tick order, applied before the step from their tick (world runs: engine/core orders; game runs: the game's `order` method)                                                                                                                                                   |
| `orders[].tick`                  | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the order applies at: after that tick's state, before the step from it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `orders[].id`                    | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       |                | >= 1                                | the order number (required on a world run): unique, ascending within a tick                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `missions`                       | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | mission steps, `{ tick, mission, action, ... }` in tick order, applied after the tick's orders, before the step from it (world runs: `outcome?`, `experienceTicks?`; game runs: the game's `mission` method, `input?` on a `play`)                                                                                    |
| `missions[].tick`                | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick it applies at: after that tick's state and orders, before the step from it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `missions[].mission`             | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`      | the mission id: on a world run its definition is &lt;id>.mission.json beside the world scenario; on a game run one of the game's missions                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `missions[].action`              | `"open" \| "delegate" \| "play" \| "quit"`                                                                   | yes      |                |                                     | `open` (freezes its event, fixes its commit tick), `delegate` (an outcome drawn by weight, seeded from the world seed and the mission id), `play` (world run: the outcome chosen; game run: the real kit round, played until it ends) or `quit` (its `onQuit` outcome); the commit comes by itself at the commit tick |
| `missions[].outcome`             | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty                           | world runs, `play` only, required there: the outcome the played round reached                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `missions[].experienceTicks`     | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       |                | >= 0                                | world runs, `play` and `quit` only: ticks spent inside the stand-in round; reported in the result, never moving the world                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `missions[].input`               | `object`                                                                                                     | no       |                |                                     | game runs, `play` only: the round's recorded input (ScriptedInput steps, frame 0 the round's first tick); left out, the round reads the run's input                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `missions[].input.steps`         | `object[]`                                                                                                   | yes      |                |                                     | each step holds its actions from its frame until the next step                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `missions[].input.steps[].frame` | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the input frame the hold starts at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `missions[].input.steps[].hold`  | `("left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down" \| "jump" \| "attack" \| "special" \| "start" \| "select" \| "run")[]` | yes      |                |                                     | the actions held from that frame on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `missions[].input.taps`          | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | pointer taps (Engine 0.15, gap D1): each on its frame, in file order within a frame; a kit that reads taps (the tower-defense kit) plays them, others ignore them                                                                                                                                                     |
| `missions[].input.taps[].frame`  | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the input frame the tap is on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `missions[].input.taps[].x`      | `number`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | where it lands: game screen pixels (the manifest's screen size)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `missions[].input.taps[].y`      | `number`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | where it lands: game screen pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `missions[].input.taps[].button` | `"primary" \| "secondary"`                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | `primary` (a left click or tap; the default) or `secondary` (a right click or long-press)                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `hashes`                         | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | sync hashes the run must give, in tick order: `run` fails at the first tick whose state hash differs                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `hashes[].tick`                  | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the hash was taken at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `hashes[].hash`                  | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | matches `^[0-9a-f]{16}$`            | the state hash at that tick                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `from`                           | `object`                                                                                                     | no       |                |                                     | game runs (Engine 0.13): start from another run's end or a save code, at the campaign's next entry, from tick 0                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `from.run`                       | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty; matches `\.run\.json$`   | a run file of the same game, relative to this one: it is played first, and this run starts from its campaign save at its last tick (the campaign's next entry)                                                                                                                                                        |
| `from.code`                      | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty                           | a save code (`pnpm cli code`): this run starts from the campaign save it packs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `start`                          | `object`                                                                                                     | no       |                |                                     | game runs (Engine 0.14): start at a later level (`{ stage }`, 0-based) or campaign entry (`{ entry }`), fresh, from tick 0, instead of the game's first; not with `from`                                                                                                                                              |
| `start.stage`                    | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       |                | >= 0                                | a level of the game's level sequence, 0-based as the snapshot's `stage`: the run starts at that level, fresh, from tick 0                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `start.entry`                    | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty                           | a campaign entry's id: the run starts at that entry, fresh (its own start, no carried record), from tick 0                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `codes`                          | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | game runs (Engine 0.13): save codes the game's campaign save must give, `{ tick, code }` in tick order; `run` fails at the first that differs                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `codes[].tick`                   | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the save code is taken at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `codes[].code`                   | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | the save code expected there (case, dashes and spaces do not matter)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `replay`                         | `object`                                                                                                     | no       |                |                                     | only in replay files: the source run, its failing check and its hashes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `replay.source`                  | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | the run file that failed, relative to the replay file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `replay.failure`                 | `object`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | the first check that failed in the source run                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `replay.failure.tick`            | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the first failing tick                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `replay.failure.kind`            | `"assertion" \| "invariant" \| "code"`                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | which list the failed check is in (`code`: a save code in `codes`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `replay.failure.path`            | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | a dotted path into the snapshot: hero.hp, entities.0.kind, entities.length                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `replay.failure.op`              | `"eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "in" \| "nin" \| "contains"`                              | yes      |                |                                     | the comparison: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, contains                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `replay.failure.expected`        | `JSON`                                                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | the check's value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `replay.failure.message`         | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | why it failed, as the source run reported it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `replay.hashes`                  | `object[]`                                                                                                   | yes      |                |                                     | the state hashes of the source run, up to the failing tick                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `replay.hashes[].tick`           | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the hash was taken at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `replay.hashes[].hash`           | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | matches `^[0-9a-f]{16}$`            | the state hash at that tick                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
