Example (`docs/reference/examples/run.json`):

```json
{
  "game": "..",
  "seed": 1,
  "ticks": 120,
  "input": {
    "steps": [
      {
        "frame": 0,
        "hold": ["right"]
      },
      {
        "frame": 60,
        "hold": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "assertions": [
    {
      "tick": 0,
      "path": "room",
      "op": "eq",
      "value": "hall"
    },
    {
      "tick": 120,
      "path": "hero.room",
      "op": "in",
      "value": ["hall", "cellar"]
    }
  ],
  "invariants": [
    {
      "path": "hero.hp",
      "op": "gte",
      "value": 0
    }
  ],
  "hashEvery": 60,
  "guards": ["doors-change-room"]
}
```

Check ops (`op` in assertions and invariants):

| Op         | Meaning                                                                           |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `eq`       | actual equals value (deep, for arrays and objects)                                |
| `ne`       | actual does not equal value                                                       |
| `lt`       | actual &lt; value (numbers)                                                       |
| `lte`      | actual &lt;= value (numbers)                                                      |
| `gt`       | actual > value (numbers)                                                          |
| `gte`      | actual >= value (numbers)                                                         |
| `in`       | actual equals one of value (an array)                                             |
| `nin`      | actual equals none of value (an array)                                            |
| `contains` | actual (an array) has an item equal to value, or actual (a string) contains value |

## World save (`saveWorld`)

The whole simulated world (Engine 0.8): seed, tick, RNG state, next entity id, every entity's components, the system names and the event log.

- Defined by: engine/sim
- Where: wherever a game keeps its saves; `saveWorld(world)` writes it, `loadWorld(json, options)` reads it
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                    | Type                                                 | Required | Default | Limits                                   | Description                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `format`                 | `"worlds-within/world"`                              | yes      |         |                                          | always `worlds-within/world`                                                                                       |
| `version`                | `1`                                                  | yes      |         |                                          | the save format version                                                                                            |
| `seed`                   | `integer`                                            | yes      |         |                                          | the seed the world was created with                                                                                |
| `tick`                   | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 0                                     | ticks committed so far                                                                                             |
| `nextId`                 | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 1                                     | the id the next spawn returns; never below an id already used                                                      |
| `rng`                    | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | 1 to 4294967295                          | the world RNG's state (`Rng.state()`)                                                                              |
| `components`             | `string[]`                                           | yes      |         | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | the registered component kinds, sorted                                                                             |
| `systems`                | `string[]`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | the system names in run order (systems are code, not saved)                                                        |
| `entities`               | `object[]`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | every live entity, ascending by id (terrain is the `Terrain` component of one of them)                             |
| `entities[].id`          | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 1                                     | the entity id                                                                                                      |
| `entities[].components`  | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                    | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`  | the entity's components by name, each checked by that component's schema                                           |
| `log`                    | `object`                                             | yes      |         |                                          | the event log and its retention                                                                                    |
| `log.enabled`            | `boolean`                                            | yes      |         |                                          | false when the world records no log                                                                                |
| `log.ticks`              | `integer \| null`                                    | yes      |         |                                          | keep only the last n committed ticks of changes; null keeps everything                                             |
| `log.events`             | `object[]`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | the kept changes, oldest first                                                                                     |
| `log.events[].tick`      | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 0                                     | the tick the change was made at                                                                                    |
| `log.events[].cause`     | `string`                                             | yes      |         | not empty                                | who made it: a system name, `external`, `order:<id>`, `scenario`, ...                                              |
| `log.events[].op`        | `"spawn" \| "destroy" \| "add" \| "set" \| "remove"` | yes      |         |                                          | what it did                                                                                                        |
| `log.events[].entity`    | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 1                                     | the entity changed                                                                                                 |
| `log.events[].component` | `string`                                             | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`        | the component, for add, set and remove                                                                             |
| `log.events[].before`    | `JSON`                                               | no       |         |                                          | the data before, for set and remove                                                                                |
| `log.events[].value`     | `JSON`                                               | no       |         |                                          | the data after, for add and set                                                                                    |
| `keys`                   | `{ <key>: integer }`                                 | no       |         | keys: not empty                          | the world's key table (Engine 0.15): each scenario key and its entity id, sorted; left out when the world has none |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/world-save.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/world",
  "version": 1,
  "seed": 7,
  "tick": 1,
  "nextId": 3,
  "rng": 7,
  "components": [
    "Construction",
    "Health",
    "Inventory",
    "Member",
    "Owner",
    "Patrol",
    "Position",
    "Squad",
    "Terrain",
    "Worker"
  ],
  "systems": ["heal"],
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "components": {
        "Terrain": {
          "width": 3,
          "height": 2,
          "types": [{ "name": "ground", "cost": 1, "passable": true }],
          "elevation": [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2],
          "cells": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "components": {
        "Health": { "hp": 4, "max": 4 },
        "Inventory": { "wood": 2 },
        "Owner": { "faction": "village" },
        "Position": { "x": 1, "y": 1, "z": 0 }
      }
    }
  ],
  "log": {
    "enabled": true,
    "ticks": null,
    "events": [
      { "tick": 0, "cause": "scenario", "op": "spawn", "entity": 1 },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 1,
        "component": "Terrain",
        "value": {
          "width": 3,
          "height": 2,
          "types": [{ "name": "ground", "cost": 1, "passable": true }],
          "elevation": [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2],
          "cells": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        }
      },
      { "tick": 0, "cause": "scenario", "op": "spawn", "entity": 2 },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Position",
        "value": { "x": 1, "y": 1, "z": 0 }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Health",
        "value": { "hp": 3, "max": 4 }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Owner",
        "value": { "faction": "village" }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Inventory",
        "value": { "wood": 2 }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "heal",
        "op": "set",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Health",
        "before": { "hp": 3, "max": 4 },
        "value": { "hp": 4, "max": 4 }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## World scenario (`worldFromScenario`)

A world written as data (Engine 0.8): the seed, the terrain as text grids of ground types and elevation digits, entities with their components, and squads with their named members.

- Defined by: engine/sim
- Where: wherever a game keeps its world starts (the engine's sample: `engine/sim/__fixtures__/village.world.json`); `worldFromScenario(json, options)` reads it
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                             | Type                                                       | Required | Default | Limits                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`                          | `"worlds-within/scenario"`                                 | yes      |         |                                                            | always `worlds-within/scenario`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `version`                         | `1`                                                        | yes      |         |                                                            | the scenario format version                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `seed`                            | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         |                                                            | the world's seed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `systems`                         | `"village" \| "rts"`                                       | no       |         |                                                            | the engine system set the world runs with: `village` (haul, build, patrol) or `rts` (the RTS units and economy); the tools use `village` when left out                                                                                                              |
| `terrain`                         | `object`                                                   | yes      |         |                                                            | the terrain grid                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `terrain.legend`                  | `{ <key>: object }`                                        | yes      |         | keys: not empty; length &lt;= 1                            | one ground type per grid character; types are numbered in sorted character order                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.name`       | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the ground type name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.cost`       | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 1                                                       | ticks to enter a cell of this type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.passable`   | `boolean`                                                  | yes      |         |                                                            | false: nothing can enter it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `terrain.rows`                    | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty                          | the grid, one string per row, north first                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `terrain.elevation`               | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | items: matches `^[0-9]+$`                                  | one elevation digit (0-9) per cell, the same size as `rows`                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `entities`                        | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | entities, spawned in this order                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `entities[].key`                  | `string`                                                   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `entities[].components`           | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                          | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`                    | components by name, each checked by its schema; `{ "$ref": "<key>" }` is an entity id                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `squads`                          | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | squads, each spawned after the entities                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `squads[].key`                    | `string`                                                   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `squads[].strength`               | `integer`                                                  | no       |         | >= 0                                                       | everyone in it; default: the named members                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `squads[].components`             | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                          | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`                    | the squad entity's other components (not `Squad`, which is built from this entry)                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `squads[].members`                | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | the named people, spawned right after their squad                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `squads[].members[].key`          | `string`                                                   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `squads[].members[].name`         | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | not empty                                                  | the person's name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `squads[].members[].role`         | `"regular" \| "hero" \| "captain"`                         | yes      |         |                                                            | at most one captain per squad                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `squads[].members[].components`   | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                          | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`                    | other components (not `Member`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `opportunities`                   | `object[]`                                                 | no       |         |                                                            | windows of world ticks in which a mission can be taken (Engine 0.10): `{ id, mission, opens, closes, exclusive?, closesOthers?, relative? }`; kept on a world-level entity spawned after the squads                                                                 |
| `opportunities[].id`              | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                             | the opportunity id, unique in the world; an `opportunity` effect names it                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `opportunities[].mission`         | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                             | the mission taking it opens; that mission opens only through an opportunity                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `opportunities[].opens`           | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 0                                                       | the first world tick it is offered (from the opening effect when `relative`)                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `opportunities[].closes`          | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 1                                                       | the world tick it closes at, untaken (from the opening effect when `relative`); after `opens`                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `opportunities[].exclusive`       | `string`                                                   | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                             | a group: taking any one closes the others in it                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `opportunities[].closesOthers`    | `string[]`                                                 | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | opportunities that close when this one is taken                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `opportunities[].relative`        | `boolean`                                                  | no       |         |                                                            | true: it waits for an `opportunity` effect to open it, and its ticks count from then                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `from`                            | `object`                                                   | no       |         |                                                            | the scenario this one follows (Engine 0.13): `{ scenario, carry: { people, stockpiles }, when? }`; a carried record built from that scenario's end world (`carriedRecord`) is applied at tick 0 under the cause `carry`; without one the scenario starts as written |
| `from.scenario`                   | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the first scenario's content id (the carried record's `from` must match)                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `from.carry`                      | `object`                                                   | yes      |         |                                                            | what carries (Engine 0.13)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `from.carry.people`               | `string[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                  | the keys of named people (squad members) whose `Health` and fate carry; keys of both scenarios                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `from.carry.stockpiles`           | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | stockpile items by faction; the faction needs a `Stockpile` in both worlds                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `from.carry.stockpiles[].faction` | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the faction whose stockpile's items carry                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `from.carry.stockpiles[].items`   | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the items whose counts carry (replacing the second scenario's)                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `from.when`                       | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | rules applied in order after the carried data: opportunities a carried fate opens                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `from.when[].key`                 | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a key of `carry.people`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `from.when[].fate`                | `"active" \| "injured" \| "captured" \| "freed" \| "dead"` | yes      |         |                                                            | the carried fate that triggers the rule                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `from.when[].open`                | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | dormant `relative` opportunities of this scenario to open at tick 0, in this order                                                                                                                                                                                  |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/world-scenario.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/scenario",
  "version": 1,
  "seed": 7,
  "terrain": {
    "legend": {
      ".": { "name": "grass", "cost": 1, "passable": true },
      "^": { "name": "hills", "cost": 2, "passable": true },
      "~": { "name": "river", "cost": 1, "passable": false }
    },
    "rows": ["..~..", "..~^^", "....^"],
    "elevation": ["11011", "11023", "11112"]
  },
  "entities": [
    { "key": "pile", "components": { "Position": { "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 1 }, "Inventory": { "wood": 20 } } },
    {
      "key": "hut",
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 4, "y": 2, "z": 2 },
        "Construction": { "kind": "hut", "progress": 0, "work": 12, "done": false },
        "Health": { "hp": 1, "max": 50 }
      }
    },
    {
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 1, "y": 0, "z": 1 },
        "Worker": { "job": { "$ref": "hut" }, "rate": 2 },
        "Walk": { "wait": 0 },
        "Hauler": {
          "item": "wood",
          "source": { "$ref": "pile" },
          "capacity": 2,
          "carry": 0,
          "rest": 0,
          "restOdds": 30,
          "restTicks": 5
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "squads": [
    {
      "key": "watch",
      "strength": 6,
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 0, "y": 2, "z": 1 },
        "Walk": { "wait": 0 },
        "Patrol": {
          "waypoints": [
            { "x": 0, "y": 2, "z": 1 },
            { "x": 4, "y": 0, "z": 1 }
          ],
          "index": 1
        }
      },
      "members": [
        { "name": "Aldric", "role": "captain" },
        { "name": "Brenna", "role": "hero" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Timeline record (`timelineOf`)

A world's time as data (Engine 0.14): the world tick, the world tick per game tick (`clock`, a game run's, run-length), frozen spans, experience per mission, opportunity windows with their status history and causes, and the missions opened and committed.

- Defined by: engine/sim
- Where: read from a world's plain data by `timelineOf` / `worldTimeline` (`engine/sim/timeline.ts`); given by `HeadlessGame.timeline()`, printed by `pnpm cli timeline`, kept in a dump file
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                              | Type                                                         | Required | Default | Limits | Description                                                                               |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`                           | `"worlds-within/timeline"`                                   | yes      |         |        | always `worlds-within/timeline`                                                           |
| `version`                          | `1`                                                          | yes      |         |        | the timeline format version                                                               |
| `worldTick`                        | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | the world tick now                                                                        |
| `logFrom`                          | `integer \| null`                                            | yes      |         |        | the oldest world tick the event log still keeps (null: no log)                            |
| `clock`                            | `object[] \| null`                                           | yes      |         |        | world tick per game tick, run-length (filled by the tools for a game run; null otherwise) |
| `frozen`                           | `object[]`                                                   | yes      |         |        | frozen spans, by start tick then event                                                    |
| `frozen[].event`                   | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the event id                                                                              |
| `frozen[].by`                      | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the cause that froze it (`mission:<id>`)                                                  |
| `frozen[].from`                    | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | the world tick it froze at                                                                |
| `frozen[].to`                      | `integer \| null`                                            | yes      |         |        | the world tick it was unfrozen at; null while still frozen                                |
| `experience`                       | `object[]`                                                   | yes      |         |        | experience time per mission, by mission id                                                |
| `experience[].mission`             | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the mission id                                                                            |
| `experience[].from`                | `integer \| null`                                            | yes      |         |        | the world tick the mission opened at (null when not known)                                |
| `experience[].ticks`               | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | experience ticks spent inside (a played round's own ticks)                                |
| `opportunities`                    | `object[]`                                                   | yes      |         |        | every opportunity, by id                                                                  |
| `opportunities[].id`               | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the opportunity id                                                                        |
| `opportunities[].mission`          | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the mission it offers                                                                     |
| `opportunities[].opens`            | `integer \| null`                                            | yes      |         |        | the world tick it opens at (null while dormant)                                           |
| `opportunities[].closes`           | `integer \| null`                                            | yes      |         |        | the world tick it closes at (null while dormant)                                          |
| `opportunities[].status`           | `"dormant" \| "waiting" \| "offered" \| "taken" \| "closed"` | yes      |         |        | its status now                                                                            |
| `opportunities[].history`          | `object[]`                                                   | yes      |         |        | its status changes, oldest first                                                          |
| `opportunities[].history[].status` | `"dormant" \| "waiting" \| "offered" \| "taken" \| "closed"` | yes      |         |        | the status it moved to                                                                    |
| `opportunities[].history[].by`     | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the cause: `time`, `mission:<id>`, `scenario`, ...                                        |
| `opportunities[].history[].at`     | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | the world tick of the change (a window's own tick when time changed it)                   |
| `missions`                         | `object[]`                                                   | yes      |         |        | committed missions in commit order, then open ones by open tick                           |
| `missions[].mission`               | `string`                                                     | yes      |         |        | the mission id                                                                            |
| `missions[].status`                | `"open" \| "committed"`                                      | yes      |         |        | open now, or committed                                                                    |
| `missions[].openTick`              | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | the world tick it opened at                                                               |
| `missions[].commitTick`            | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | the world tick its result commits (or committed) at, fixed at open                        |
| `missions[].resolution`            | `"played" \| "quit" \| "delegated" \| "timeout" \| null`     | yes      |         |        | how it was resolved (null while open and unresolved)                                      |
| `missions[].outcome`               | `string \| null`                                             | yes      |         |        | the outcome (null while open and unresolved)                                              |
| `missions[].experienceTicks`       | `integer`                                                    | yes      |         | >= 0   | experience ticks recorded in the world (a game run counts its own)                        |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/timeline.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/timeline",
  "version": 1,
  "worldTick": 60,
  "logFrom": 0,
  "clock": [
    {
      "game": 0,
      "world": 0
    },
    {
      "game": 5,
      "world": 5
    },
    {
      "game": 245,
      "world": 5
    },
    {
      "game": 300,
      "world": 60
    }
  ],
  "frozen": [
    {
      "event": "siege",
      "by": "mission:raid",
      "from": 5,
      "to": 35
    }
  ],
  "experience": [
    {
      "mission": "raid",
      "from": 5,
      "ticks": 240
    }
  ],
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "id": "night-raid",
      "mission": "raid",
      "opens": 0,
      "closes": 60,
      "status": "taken",
      "history": [
        {
          "status": "waiting",
          "by": "scenario",
          "at": 0
        },
        {
          "status": "offered",
          "by": "time",
          "at": 0
        },
        {
          "status": "taken",
          "by": "mission:raid",
          "at": 5
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "scout-gap",
      "mission": "scout",
      "opens": 0,
      "closes": 25,
      "status": "closed",
      "history": [
        {
          "status": "waiting",
          "by": "scenario",
          "at": 0
        },
        {
          "status": "offered",
          "by": "time",
          "at": 0
        },
        {
          "status": "closed",
          "by": "time",
          "at": 25
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "missions": [
    {
      "mission": "raid",
      "status": "committed",
      "openTick": 5,
      "commitTick": 35,
      "resolution": "played",
      "outcome": "partial",
      "experienceTicks": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

## Dump file (`dump --out`)

One tick of a run as a still picture (Engine 0.14): the dump result (state, orders and mission steps applied, hash) with the world's event log and timeline there, paths relative to the file.

- Defined by: engine/tools
- Where: wherever `pnpm cli dump <run-file> --tick N --out <file>.json` writes it; the debugger reads it
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type                       | Required | Default | Limits                   | Description                                                         |
| ---------- | -------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`   | `"worlds-within/dump"`     | yes      |         |                          | always `worlds-within/dump`                                         |
| `version`  | `1`                        | yes      |         |                          | the dump format version                                             |
| `run`      | `string`                   | yes      |         | not empty                | the run file it was played from, relative to the dump file          |
| `game`     | `string \| null`           | yes      |         |                          | the game folder, relative to the dump file (null for a world run)   |
| `world`    | `string \| null`           | yes      |         |                          | the world scenario, relative to the dump file (null for a game run) |
| `seed`     | `integer`                  | yes      |         |                          | the seed the run used                                               |
| `start`    | `object \| object \| null` | yes      |         |                          | the run file's start (a stage or campaign entry), or null           |
| `tick`     | `integer`                  | yes      |         | >= 0                     | the game (or world run) tick shown                                  |
| `hash`     | `string`                   | yes      |         | matches `^[0-9a-f]{16}$` | the state hash at that tick                                         |
| `state`    | `{ <key>: JSON }`          | yes      |         |                          | the whole snapshot at that tick                                     |
| `orders`   | `({ <key>: JSON })[]`      | yes      |         |                          | the recorded orders applied before the tick                         |
| `missions` | `({ <key>: JSON })[]`      | yes      |         |                          | the mission steps applied before the tick                           |
| `events`   | `object \| null`           | yes      |         |                          | the world's kept event log up to the tick (null: no world)          |
| `timeline` | `object \| null`           | yes      |         |                          | the timeline record at the tick (null: no world)                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/dump-file.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/dump",
  "version": 1,
  "run": "../games/samples/mini-siege/runs/played.run.json",
  "game": "../games/samples/mini-siege",
  "world": null,
  "seed": 11,
  "start": null,
  "tick": 41,
  "hash": "0123456789abcdef",
  "state": { "world": { "tick": 40 }, "named": { "ram": { "alive": true, "x": 9, "y": 4, "hp": 30 } } },
  "orders": [],
  "missions": [{ "tick": 40, "mission": "sabotage", "action": "open" }],
  "events": {
    "from": 0,
    "tick": 40,
    "changes": [
      {
        "tick": 40,
        "cause": "mission:sabotage",
        "op": "set",
        "entity": 29,
        "component": "WorldTime",
        "before": { "frozen": [], "experience": [], "committed": [] },
        "value": {
          "frozen": [{ "event": "siege", "by": "mission:sabotage", "since": 40 }],
          "experience": [],
          "committed": []
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "timeline": {
    "format": "worlds-within/timeline",
    "version": 1,
    "worldTick": 40,
    "logFrom": 0,
    "clock": [
      { "game": 0, "world": 0 },
      { "game": 40, "world": 40 },
      { "game": 41, "world": 40 }
    ],
    "frozen": [{ "event": "siege", "by": "mission:sabotage", "from": 40, "to": null }],
    "experience": [{ "mission": "sabotage", "from": 40, "ticks": 1 }],
    "opportunities": [],
    "missions": [
      {
        "mission": "sabotage",
        "status": "open",
        "openTick": 40,
        "commitTick": 160,
        "resolution": null,
        "outcome": null,
        "experienceTicks": 0
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Carried record (`carriedRecord`)

What carries from one scenario's end world into the scenario that names it in `from` (Engine 0.13): each carried person's fate and `Health`, and stockpile item counts, keys sorted.

- Defined by: engine/sim
- Where: built from a scenario's end world by `carriedRecord(world, from, keys)`; `worldFromScenario(json, { carried })` reads it
- Read from: `.json`

| Field               | Type                                                       | Required | Default | Limits                                   | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`            | `"worlds-within/carried"`                                  | yes      |         |                                          | always `worlds-within/carried`                                               |
| `version`           | `1`                                                        | yes      |         |                                          | the carried record version                                                   |
| `from`              | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`       | the first scenario's content id (the second scenario's `from.scenario`)      |
| `tick`              | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 0                                     | the first world tick the record was taken at                                 |
| `people`            | `{ <key>: object }`                                        | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | one entry per key of the carry spec's `people`, sorted by key                |
| `people.<key>.fate` | `"active" \| "injured" \| "captured" \| "freed" \| "dead"` | yes      |         |                                          | `active` or a `Fate` state                                                   |
| `people.<key>.by`   | `string \| null`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | who captured or killed them (null while active or not known)                 |
| `people.<key>.at`   | `integer \| null`                                          | yes      |         |                                          | the first world tick the state was reached (null while active)               |
| `people.<key>.hp`   | `integer \| null`                                          | yes      |         |                                          | `Health.hp` at the first world's end (null: no `Health`)                     |
| `people.<key>.max`  | `integer \| null`                                          | yes      |         |                                          | `Health.max` (null exactly when `hp` is)                                     |
| `stockpiles`        | `{ <key>: { <key>: integer } }`                            | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | item counts by faction, then item, for the carry spec's `stockpiles`, sorted |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/carried-record.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/carried",
  "version": 1,
  "from": "captive",
  "tick": 12,
  "people": {
    "captain": { "fate": "captured", "by": "raiders", "at": 12, "hp": 20, "max": 30 },
    "sergeant": { "fate": "active", "by": null, "at": null, "hp": 30, "max": 30 }
  },
  "stockpiles": { "village": { "gold": 200 } }
}
```

## Campaign save (`campaignSaveSchema`)

Where a campaign run is and what it carries (Engine 0.13): the entry played now, the carried record the next scenario starts from, and the missions committed in every finished entry; never a whole world.

- Defined by: engine/core
- Where: a game's campaign run state: kept in browser storage under `ww:<game>:campaign:<id>` (`engine/core/save/campaign-store.ts`), packed into a save code by `encodeSaveCode` (`engine/core/campaign-code.ts`), given by `HeadlessGame.campaignSave()`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                             | Type                                             | Required | Default | Limits                             | Description                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`                          | `"worlds-within/campaign-save"`                  | yes      |         |                                    | always `worlds-within/campaign-save`                                                                                  |
| `version`                         | `1`                                              | yes      |         |                                    | the campaign save version                                                                                             |
| `game`                            | `string`                                         | yes      |         | not empty                          | the game's id (`id` in `game.json`)                                                                                   |
| `campaign`                        | `string`                                         | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | the campaign id                                                                                                       |
| `seed`                            | `integer`                                        | yes      |         |                                    | the run's seed                                                                                                        |
| `position`                        | `integer`                                        | yes      |         | >= 0                               | the entry played now: its index in play order (the number of entries finished); past the last: done                   |
| `carried`                         | `object \| null`                                 | yes      |         |                                    | the carried record the next scenario entry starts from (`engine/sim/carry.ts`), or null                               |
| `results`                         | `object[]`                                       | yes      |         |                                    | one per finished entry, in play order                                                                                 |
| `results[].entry`                 | `integer`                                        | yes      |         | >= 0                               | the finished entry: its index in play order                                                                           |
| `results[].missions`              | `object[]`                                       | yes      |         |                                    | the missions committed while it was played                                                                            |
| `results[].missions[].mission`    | `string`                                         | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | the mission id                                                                                                        |
| `results[].missions[].outcome`    | `string`                                         | yes      |         | not empty                          | the committed outcome's id (one the mission file declares)                                                            |
| `results[].missions[].resolution` | `"played" \| "delegated" \| "quit" \| "timeout"` | yes      |         |                                    | how it was resolved: played, delegated, quit or timeout                                                               |
| `ended`                           | `object`                                         | no       |         |                                    | Engine 0.15 (gap M31): the campaign ended on a loss its data declares (an entry's `endIf`); left out while it goes on |
| `ended.entry`                     | `integer`                                        | yes      |         | >= 0                               | the entry the campaign ended at: its index in play order                                                              |
| `ended.reason`                    | `object`                                         | yes      |         |                                    | the entry's `endIf` that held                                                                                         |
| `ended.reason.gone`               | `string`                                         | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | a scenario key of the entry's world: the campaign ends when that entity is not alive at the entry's end               |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/campaign-save.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/campaign-save",
  "version": 1,
  "game": "mini-siege",
  "campaign": "siege",
  "seed": 11,
  "position": 1,
  "carried": {
    "format": "worlds-within/carried",
    "version": 1,
    "from": "village",
    "tick": 400,
    "people": {
      "captain": { "fate": "captured", "by": "raiders", "at": 161, "hp": 90, "max": 120 }
    },
    "stockpiles": { "village": { "gold": 70 } }
  },
  "results": [
    {
      "entry": 0,
      "missions": [
        { "mission": "fortify", "outcome": "held", "resolution": "delegated" },
        { "mission": "sabotage", "outcome": "driven-off", "resolution": "quit" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Content kinds

The engine defines some kinds and each kit adds its own (`engine/tools/kits.ts`); a game claims
files for each kind in `game.json`.

### RTS unit and building types (`rtsTypesSchema`)

The unit and building types an RTS world makes things from (Engine 0.9): stats, costs, build and training time, what a building trains and whether it takes drop-offs.

- Defined by: engine/core
- Where: a game's RTS data, held in the world by the `RtsTypes` component (in a world scenario: an entity's `RtsTypes`)
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                     | Type                 | Required | Default | Limits                                    | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `units`                   | `{ <key>: object }`  | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | unit types by id                                                                                            |
| `units.<key>.health`      | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | hit points of a new unit (Health.max)                                                                       |
| `units.<key>.speed`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks to cross one cell of cost 1 in a straight line                                                        |
| `units.<key>.attack`      | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                                      | damage per hit (0: it never hurts anything)                                                                 |
| `units.<key>.range`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | how far it hits, in whole cells                                                                             |
| `units.<key>.cooldown`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks from one hit to the next                                                                              |
| `units.<key>.sight`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                                      | how far it sees, in whole cells (for the view)                                                              |
| `units.<key>.cost`        | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `units.<key>.trainTicks`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks a building takes to train one                                                                         |
| `units.<key>.work`        | `integer \| null`    | no       | `null`  |                                           | construction work it adds per tick; only units with it can build                                            |
| `units.<key>.gather`      | `object \| null`     | no       | `null`  |                                           | { capacity, ticks }: it carries at most capacity, one item every ticks ticks; only units with it can gather |
| `buildings`               | `{ <key>: object }`  | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | building types by id                                                                                        |
| `buildings.<key>.health`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | hit points once built (Health.max)                                                                          |
| `buildings.<key>.size`    | `object`             | yes      |         |                                           | its footprint in cells, from its Position (the north-west cell)                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.size.w`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | width in cells, west to east                                                                                |
| `buildings.<key>.size.h`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | height in cells, north to south                                                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.work`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | construction work to finish it (build time: work / the workers' rates)                                      |
| `buildings.<key>.cost`    | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `buildings.<key>.trains`  | `string[]`           | no       | `[]`    | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the unit types it can train, once finished                                                                  |
| `buildings.<key>.dropoff` | `boolean`            | no       | `false` |                                           | whether gatherers can drop resources here, once finished                                                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/rts-types.json`):

```json
{
  "units": {
    "worker": {
      "health": 20,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 1,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 4,
      "sight": 5,
      "cost": { "gold": 50 },
      "trainTicks": 30,
      "work": 2,
      "gather": { "capacity": 5, "ticks": 4 }
    },
    "soldier": {
      "health": 40,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 5,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 6,
      "sight": 6,
      "cost": { "gold": 60 },
      "trainTicks": 45
    }
  },
  "buildings": {
    "hall": { "health": 600, "size": { "w": 3, "h": 3 }, "work": 300, "trains": ["worker"], "dropoff": true },
    "barracks": {
      "health": 300,
      "size": { "w": 2, "h": 2 },
      "work": 120,
      "cost": { "gold": 100 },
      "trains": ["soldier"]
    }
  }
}
```

### `campaign`

A campaign: the order a game plays its levels, missions and world scenarios in, as a list of level, mission and scenario ids (a scenario with the ticks it is played), with an optional entry to start at.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.campaign`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                  | Type       | Required | Default | Limits                             | Description                                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `version`              | `1`        | yes      |         |                                    | the campaign format version: 1                                                                                                                                         |
| `id`                   | `string`   | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | the campaign id; the same as the file name                                                                                                                             |
| `title`                | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | one line naming the campaign                                                                                                                                           |
| `entries`              | `object[]` | yes      |         | at least 1 item                    | the play order: `{ "level": id }`, `{ "mission": id }` or `{ "scenario": id, "ticks": n }` each, every named level, mission and scenario in the game                   |
| `entries[].level`      | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | a level id (the level file name)                                                                                                                                       |
| `entries[].mission`    | `string`   | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`     | a mission id (the `*.mission.json` file name)                                                                                                                          |
| `entries[].scenario`   | `string`   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | a world scenario id (Engine 0.13): the file name of a content file in the `worlds-within/scenario` format                                                              |
| `entries[].ticks`      | `integer`  | no       |         | >= 1                               | with `scenario` only (and required there): how many world ticks the scenario is played                                                                                 |
| `entries[].title`      | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | one line naming the entry for a page (Engine 0.13 T8), e.g. a scenario's name                                                                                          |
| `entries[].text`       | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | a few sentences a page shows before the entry begins (Engine 0.15, gap M34): the briefing, read while the entry is held at tick 0                                      |
| `entries[].endIf`      | `object`   | no       |         |                                    | with `scenario` only (Engine 0.15, gap M31): the loss that ends the campaign at this entry's end, `{ "gone": "<scenario key>" }` (that keyed entity is not alive then) |
| `entries[].endIf.gone` | `string`   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | a scenario key of the entry's world: the campaign ends when that entity is not alive at the entry's end                                                                |
| `start`                | `string`   | no       |         | not empty                          | the id of the entry played first; the first entry when left out                                                                                                        |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/campaign.json`):

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "id": "main",
  "title": "The first chapter",
  "entries": [
    { "level": "level-1" },
    { "level": "level-2" },
    { "mission": "raid" },
    { "scenario": "village", "ticks": 400 },
    { "level": "level-3" }
  ],
  "start": "level-1"
}
```

### `font`

A bitmap pixel font: one-bit glyph grids on a cell, a baseline, spacing, per-glyph advance and kerning pairs.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.font`
- Read from: `.json` or `.txt`

| Field                  | Type                 | Required | Default | Limits                   | Description                                                       |
| ---------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cell`                 | `object`             | yes      |         |                          | the glyph cell                                                    |
| `cell.w`               | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 64                  | the widest glyph, px                                              |
| `cell.h`               | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 64                  | the cell height, px: every glyph has this many rows               |
| `baseline`             | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                     | rows above the baseline; descenders sit below it                  |
| `spacing`              | `integer`            | no       |         | >= 0                     | px between glyphs (default 1)                                     |
| `space`                | `integer`            | no       |         | >= 0                     | a space's advance (default half the cell width, rounded up)       |
| `line`                 | `integer`            | no       |         | >= 1                     | px from one line to the next (default the cell height + 2)        |
| `glyphs`               | `{ <key>: object }`  | yes      |         |                          | character -> glyph                                                |
| `glyphs.<key>.rows`    | `string[]`           | yes      |         | items: matches `^[#.]*$` | the rows, top to bottom: `#` ink, `.` clear; one per cell row     |
| `glyphs.<key>.advance` | `integer`            | no       |         | >= 0                     | px from this glyph to the next (default its width plus `spacing`) |
| `kerning`              | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       |         |                          | a pair of characters (`AV`) -> px added between them              |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/font.txt`):

```text
; A bitmap font: one-bit glyphs ('#' ink, '.' clear) on a 4x6 cell, baseline 5.
cell 4 6
baseline 5
spacing 1
space 2
kern Hi 0

glyph H
#..#
#..#
####
#..#
#..#
....

glyph i advance 2
#
.
#
#
#
.

glyph 1
.#.
##.
.#.
.#.
###
...
```

### `mission`

A mission: its event, fixed world-time cost, the mini game it is played with, its params and its declared outcomes with delegation weights and effects.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.mission`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                | Type                                                           | Required | Default | Limits                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                 | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the mission id; the same as the file name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `title`              | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                              | shown when the mission is offered                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `event`              | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the event it belongs to, held frozen while it is open; none freezes nothing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `marker`             | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                              | the scenario key of the entity the offer marker stands over (Engine 0.15); left out, the kit's own choice (the RTS kit: a unit of the mission's event)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `worldTimeCost`      | `integer`                                                      | yes      |         | >= 1                                                   | world ticks between opening and the commit, fixed when it opens (whole number, at least 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `play`               | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the mini game (or kit round) a player plays it with; left out, the mission is a choice that is only delegated                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `params`             | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                              | no       |         |                                                        | data handed to the mini game, checked by its params schema                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `hint`               | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                              | the key hint a page shows while the mission's round is played (Engine 0.15); left out, the mini game's own controls written with the player's keys                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `outcomes`           | `object[]`                                                     | yes      |         | at least 1 item                                        | the declared outcome space, in the order delegation walks it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `outcomes[].id`      | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the outcome id, unique in the mission; a kit report names it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
