| `outcomes[].title`   | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                              | a short line for a report card, e.g. "Two of three burnt"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `outcomes[].weight`  | `integer`                                                      | no       | `1`     | >= 1                                                   | its share when the mission is delegated (whole number, at least 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `outcomes[].effects` | `(object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object)[]` | no       | `[]`    |                                                        | the world changes it makes at the commit, in this order, each told apart by `type`: `damage` `{ entity \| each, amount, fromReport?, max?, entities?, owner? }`, `destroy` `{ entity \| each, entities?, owner?, max? }`, `inventory` `{ entity, item, add, fromReport?, negate?, max? }`, `set` `{ entity, component, values }`, `opportunity` `{ open }` or `{ close }`, `fate` `{ entity, fate, by?, at? }` (`fate` injured, captured, freed or dead; `at`, a cell `{ x, y }`, on freed only and required there); `entity` is a scenario key or an entity id |
| `onQuit`             | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the outcome a played mission commits when the player quits                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `playable`           | `string[]`                                                     | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | the outcomes a player can reach by playing; all of them when left out                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/mission.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "raid",
  "title": "Burn the siege engines",
  "event": "siege",
  "worldTimeCost": 30,
  "play": "sabotage",
  "params": { "engines": 3 },
  "onQuit": "repelled",
  "outcomes": [
    {
      "id": "clean",
      "title": "All three burnt",
      "weight": 1,
      "effects": [
        { "type": "destroy", "entity": "ram" },
        { "type": "destroy", "entity": "tower" }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "partial",
      "title": "Two of three burnt",
      "weight": 2,
      "effects": [
        { "type": "destroy", "entity": "ram" },
        { "type": "damage", "entity": "tower", "amount": 20 }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "repelled",
      "title": "Driven off",
      "weight": 1,
      "effects": [
        { "type": "inventory", "entity": "camp", "item": "oil", "add": -2 },
        { "type": "opportunity", "open": "rescue" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `palette`

A named list of colours (#rgb or #rrggbb) that sprite indices pick from.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.palette`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field    | Type       | Required | Default | Limits                                                                | Description                                                                 |
| -------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | `string`   | yes      |         | not empty                                                             | the palette name sprites give in `palette`                                  |
| `colors` | `string[]` | yes      |         | 1 to 36 items; items: matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the colours, "#rgb" or "#rrggbb"; a sprite index picks one (0 is the first) |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/palette.json`):

```json
{ "id": "hero", "colors": ["#000000", "#00a800", "#fca044", "#fcfcfc"] }
```

### `sfx`

An MML sound effect: id, optional bpm and up to four voices.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.sfx`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type     | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                       |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string` | yes      |         | not empty       | the sound id the game plays it by |
| `bpm`      | `number` | no       |         | &lt;= 1000; > 0 | tempo in beats per minute         |
| `pulse`    | `string` | no       |         |                 | the pulse channel's MML           |
| `pulse2`   | `string` | no       |         |                 | the second pulse channel's MML    |
| `triangle` | `string` | no       |         |                 | the triangle channel's MML        |
| `noise`    | `string` | no       |         |                 | the noise channel's MML           |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/sfx.json`):

```json
{ "id": "chime", "bpm": 240, "pulse": "v12 @1 l16 o5 c e g > c" }
```

### `skin`

How a backend shows a game: each kind as a sprite or mesh, tiles, event sounds and effects, the HUD.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.skin`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                               | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Required | Default | Limits                                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `backend`                           | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | yes      |         | not empty                                                               | the backend it is for: `canvas2d`, `three` (meshes) or another backend name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `background`                        | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | the colour the backend clears to before each frame it draws with this skin (default `#000`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `sheets`                            | `object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | defaults for entries that leave a field out                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `sheets.sheet`                      | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | the sprite file for entries that name none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sheets.palette`                    | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | the palette for entries that name none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `sheets.fallbackColor`              | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | the box colour for entries that give none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `kinds`                             | `{ <key>: object }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | yes      |         | keys: not empty                                                         | entity kind -> how it looks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `kinds.<key>.sheet`                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: the sprite file the frames are in (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `kinds.<key>.palette`               | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: a palette to draw with instead of the sprite's own                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `kinds.<key>.frames`                | `{ <key>: string \| object }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         | keys: not empty                                                         | 2D: animation state -> a frame name, `{ frames, ticks?, loop? }` (a cycle) or `{ up?, down?, left?, right?, up-left?, up-right?, down-left?, down-right? }` (a frame or cycle per facing, all optional; a diagonal left out uses its horizontal part); `idle` is used for a state not listed                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kinds.<key>.flipFacing`            | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | 2D: draw the right-hand frames mirrored when the entity faces left or a left-hand diagonal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kinds.<key>.size`                  | `object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | 2D: the drawn size, when it is not the frame size                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `kinds.<key>.size.w`                | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | yes      |         | >= 1                                                                    | width in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.size.h`                | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | yes      |         | >= 1                                                                    | height in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.fallbackColor`         | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | 2D: the box colour when a frame is missing (default `sheets.fallbackColor`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `kinds.<key>.mesh`                  | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kinds.<key>.color`                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | 3D: the mesh's colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `kinds.<key>.poses`                 | `{ <key>: string \| object }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         | keys: not empty                                                         | 3D: animation state -> a mesh (a primitive or a key of `meshes`), a cycle of meshes or a mesh or cycle per facing, read as `frames` is (timing, `loop`, `then`, frame `events`, the `idle` fallback); without `poses` the entry's `mesh` is shown                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `kinds.<key>.scale`                 | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | > 0                                                                     | 3D: size factor about the box's bottom centre (default 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `kinds.<key>.depth`                 | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | > 0                                                                     | 3D: a primitive mesh's thickness in px (default: the box's width; a tile is one tile deep)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kinds.<key>.z`                     | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | 3D: px toward the camera from the depth plane (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `kinds.<key>.offset`                | `object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | where the sprite or mesh sits from the entity box's top-left corner                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kinds.<key>.offset.x`              | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | yes      |         |                                                                         | pixels right                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kinds.<key>.offset.y`              | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | yes      |         |                                                                         | pixels down                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `kinds.<key>.spawnTween`            | `object \| object \| (object \| object)[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no       |         |                                                                         | tweens started on an entity of this kind the first frame a presenter shows it (a pop-in), on top of its `fx`; presentation only (Engine 0.16)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds.<key>.emit`                  | `string \| string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | no       |         |                                                                         | emitters that run while an entity of this kind shows, following it (torch smoke, a magic aura); presentation only (Engine 0.16)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.blend`                 | `"normal" \| "add"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no       |         |                                                                         | 2D: `add` draws the sprite additively, brightening what is under it (default `normal`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `kinds.<key>.glow`                  | `object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | 2D: a soft glow round the sprite                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.glow.color`            | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | yes      |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | the glow colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.glow.radius`           | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | yes      |         | > 0                                                                     | the blur radius in picture px                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag`                 | `object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no       |         |                                                                         | looks by entity tag, `{ tag \| prefix, min?, max?, sheet?, palette?, frames?, fallbackColor?, mesh?, color? }`: the first entry in file order that matches one of the entity's tags (`tag`: the whole tag; `prefix`: any tag starting with it, and with `min`/`max` only one whose rest is a whole number in that inclusive range, such as `progress:` 50-99) replaces those fields of the kind's; the state and facing are then picked as usual |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].tag`           | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | the whole entity tag it is for (`used`, `look:door`, `site`); or give `prefix`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].prefix`        | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | instead of `tag`: any entity tag that starts with it (`progress:`); `min` and `max` read the rest                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].min`           | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | with `prefix`: the rest of the tag read as a whole number is at least this                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].max`           | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | with `prefix`: the rest of the tag read as a whole number is at most this                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].sheet`         | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: the sprite file (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].palette`       | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: a palette to draw with (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].frames`        | `{ <key>: string \| object }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         | keys: not empty                                                         | 2D: the frames by animation state, as the kind's `frames`, used instead of them                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].fallbackColor` | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | 2D: the box colour when a frame is missing (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].mesh`          | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kinds.<key>.byTag[].color`         | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | 3D: the mesh's colour (default the kind's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `tiles`                             | `{ <key>: object }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no       |         | keys: not empty                                                         | map tile character or id -> how it looks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `tiles.<key>.sheet`                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: the sprite file (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tiles.<key>.frame`                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: the frame name in the sheet                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `tiles.<key>.fallbackColor`         | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | 2D: the colour when the frame is missing (default `sheets.fallbackColor`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `tiles.<key>.mesh`                  | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tiles.<key>.color`                 | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$`                         | 3D: the mesh's colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

| `emitters.<key>.angle`              | `number \| [number, number]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | no       |         |                                                                         | start direction in degrees (0 right, 90 down, 270 up): one number, or [min, max] drawn per particle                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `emitters.<key>.even`               | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | spread a burst evenly across `angle` instead of at random (a ring)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `emitters.<key>.gravity`            | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | px per frame added to the downward speed each frame (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `emitters.<key>.drag`               | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | 0 to 1                                                                  | the share of its speed a particle loses each frame (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `emitters.<key>.shape`              | `"point" \| object \| object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         |                                                                         | where particles are born round the emitter: `point`, `{ circle: r }` or `{ box: { w, h } }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `emitters.<key>.offset`             | `object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | world px from the anchor point to the emitter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `emitters.<key>.offset.x`           | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | yes      |         |                                                                         | world px right                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `emitters.<key>.offset.y`           | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | yes      |         |                                                                         | world px down                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `emitters.<key>.anchor`             | `"centre" \| "feet" \| "top"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         |                                                                         | on an entity: its box's centre, bottom centre (`feet`) or top centre (default centre)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `emitters.<key>.follow`             | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | started by an event: keep moving with the event's entity while it runs (a kind's emitter always does)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `emitters.<key>.size`               | `number \| number[] \| object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | no       |         |                                                                         | size in world px over the particle's life: one value, a list spaced evenly from birth to death, or a list of `{ at, value }` stops (at 0 to 1, ascending)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `emitters.<key>.color`              | `string \| string[] \| object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | no       |         |                                                                         | colour over the particle's life: one value, a list spaced evenly from birth to death, or a list of `{ at, value }` stops (at 0 to 1, ascending)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `emitters.<key>.alpha`              | `number \| number[] \| object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | no       |         |                                                                         | opacity over the particle's life: one value, a list spaced evenly from birth to death, or a list of `{ at, value }` stops (at 0 to 1, ascending)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `emitters.<key>.frame`              | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: a sprite frame drawn for each particle instead of a square (3D draws squares)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `emitters.<key>.sheet`              | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | 2D: the frame's sprite file (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `emitters.<key>.blend`              | `"normal" \| "add"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no       |         |                                                                         | `add` brightens what is under it (fire, sparks, magic); default `normal`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `emitters.<key>.glow`               | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | > 0                                                                     | 2D: a soft glow of this radius in px round each particle                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `emitters.<key>.max`                | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         | >= 1                                                                    | the most particles of one running emitter alive at once (default 64)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `parallax`                          | `object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no       |         |                                                                         | background layers behind the map, back to front (Engine 0.16): `{ frame \| gradient, factor, repeat?, x?, y?, sheet?, bands?, height?, depth? }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `parallax[].frame`                  | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | a sprite frame drawn as the layer (or give `gradient`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `parallax[].sheet`                  | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | not empty                                                               | the frame's sprite file (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `parallax[].gradient`               | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | colours from top to bottom, blended in `bands` flat steps (or give `frame`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `parallax[].bands`                  | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         | 1 to 64                                                                 | a gradient's flat steps (default 8)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `parallax[].height`                 | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         | >= 1                                                                    | a gradient's height in picture px (default the picture's)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `parallax[].factor`                 | `number \| object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | yes      |         |                                                                         | how fast it scrolls with the camera: 0 stays put on the screen (a sky), 1 moves with the world; one number or `{ x, y }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `parallax[].repeat`                 | `"x" \| "y" \| "xy" \| "none"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | no       |         |                                                                         | a frame repeats across (`x`, the default), down (`y`), both (`xy`) or not (`none`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `parallax[].x`                      | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | picture px right of the scroll origin (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `parallax[].y`                      | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         |                                                                         | its top in picture px when the camera is at the world's top (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `parallax[].depth`                  | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         | > 0                                                                     | 3D: how far behind the blocks the plane stands, in px (default further back for earlier layers)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `music`                             | `{ <key>: object }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no       |         | keys: not empty                                                         | layered songs (Engine 0.16): id -> `{ layers: { name: song }, fade?, mix?: [{ when?: { status, eq \| ne \| lt \| lte \| gt \| gte }, layers: { name: level }, fade? }] }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `music.<key>.layers`                | `{ <key>: string }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | yes      |         | keys: not empty                                                         | layer name -> the song (MML) it plays; all start together and stay in step                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `music.<key>.fade`                  | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         | 0 to 600                                                                | the default crossfade ticks for its rules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
