| `music.<key>.mix`                   | `object[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no       |         |                                                                         | rules tried in order each tick on the frame's status; the first that holds sets the levels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when`            | `object`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | when the rule holds (left out: always)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.status`     | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | yes      |         | not empty                                                               | the frame's status key                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.eq`         | `string \| number \| boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         |                                                                         | equal to                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.ne`         | `string \| number \| boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | no       |         |                                                                         | not equal to                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.lt`         | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | a number below                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.lte`        | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | a number at most                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.gt`         | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | a number above                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `music.<key>.mix[].when.gte`        | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | no       |         |                                                                         | a number at least                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `music.<key>.mix[].layers`          | `{ <key>: number }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | yes      |         | keys: not empty                                                         | layer name -> its level (0..1) while the rule holds                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `music.<key>.mix[].fade`            | `integer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | no       |         | 0 to 600                                                                | crossfade ticks to these levels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/skin.json`):

```json
{
  "backend": "canvas2d",
  "sheets": { "sheet": "hero", "palette": "hero", "fallbackColor": "#00a800" },
  "kinds": {
    "hero": {
      "frames": {
        "idle": { "down": "down-0", "up": "up-0", "right": "side-0" },
        "walk": {
          "down": { "frames": ["down-0", "down-1"], "ticks": 8 },
          "right": { "frames": ["side-0", "side-1"], "ticks": 8 }
        },
        "hurt": "hurt"
      },
      "flipFacing": true
    },
    "bat": {
      "sheet": "bat",
      "frames": { "fly": { "frames": ["a", "b"], "ticks": 6 } },
      "fallbackColor": "#a800a8"
    }
  },
  "tiles": { "#": { "sheet": "walls", "frame": "wall", "fallbackColor": "#7c7c7c" } },
  "events": {
    "hit": { "sound": "hurt", "effect": { "kind": "flash", "color": "#fcfcfc", "ticks": 4 } },
    "coin": { "sound": "coin" }
  },
  "hud": [
    { "status": "health", "as": "hearts", "x": 8, "y": 8, "sheet": "hud", "frame": "heart" },
    { "status": "score", "as": "number", "x": 200, "y": 8 }
  ],
  "camera": { "follow": "hero", "lerp": 0.25 }
}
```

### `song`

An MML song: id, bpm, loop and up to four channels.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.song`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type      | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                                             |
| ---------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`  | yes      |         | not empty       | the song id rooms and scenes name it by                 |
| `bpm`      | `number`  | yes      |         | &lt;= 1000; > 0 | tempo in beats per minute                               |
| `loop`     | `boolean` | yes      |         |                 | start again at the `L` mark (or the start) when it ends |
| `pulse1`   | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the first pulse channel's MML                           |
| `pulse2`   | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the second pulse channel's MML                          |
| `triangle` | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the triangle channel's MML                              |
| `noise`    | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the noise channel's MML                                 |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/song.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "theme",
  "bpm": 120,
  "loop": true,
  "pulse1": "v10 @2 l8 o4 L [c e g > c < g e]2 d f a f",
  "triangle": "l4 o3 L [c g]2 d a"
}
```

### `sprite`

Text-grid pixel art: a palette name, an optional legend and named frames.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.sprite`
- Read from: `.json` or `.txt`

| Field          | Type                            | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                                                                           |
| -------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `palette`      | `string`                        | yes      |         | not empty       | the id of the palette the indices pick from                                           |
| `legend`       | `{ <key>: "clear" \| integer }` | no       |         |                 | character -> "clear" or a palette index; without it rows use `.` and `0`-`9`, `a`-`z` |
| `legend.<key>` | `"clear" \| integer`            | no       |         |                 | "clear" (transparent) or a palette index 0-35                                         |
| `frames`       | `{ <key>: string[] }`           | yes      |         | keys: not empty | frame name -> its rows (a text grid)                                                  |
| `frames.<key>` | `string[]`                      | no       |         |                 | the rows: equal-width strings of legend characters                                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/sprite.txt`):

```text
; A 4x4 gem in two frames. Comments start with ";".
palette hero
legend . clear
legend k 0
legend g 1
legend w 3

frame idle
.kk.
kgwk
kggk
.kk.

frame shine
.kk.
kwgk
kggk
.kk.
```

### `ui`

A UI screen: a style (font, colours, panel frame, sounds, focus and press tweens) and widgets placed by anchors: panels, text, buttons, menus with sliders and toggles, and dialog boxes.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.ui`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                 | Type                                                           | Required | Default | Limits                                          | Description                                                                     |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `style`               | `object`                                                       | yes      |         |                                                 | how a screen looks and sounds                                                   |
| `style.font`          | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                       | the font file text is drawn in                                                  |
| `style.text`          | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | text colour (default `#fcfcfc`)                                                 |
| `style.shadow`        | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | a one-px drop shadow under text                                                 |
| `style.focusText`     | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the focused item's text (default `#f8b800`)                                     |
| `style.disabledText`  | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | a disabled item's text (default `#7c7c7c`)                                      |
| `style.back`          | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | a panel's fill without a frame (default `#000000`)                              |
| `style.focusBack`     | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the bar behind the focused item (default `#24188c`)                             |
| `style.border`        | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | a frameless panel's one-px border (default `#fcfcfc`)                           |
| `style.track`         | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | a slider's empty track (default `#3c3c3c`)                                      |
| `style.fill`          | `string`                                                       | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | a slider's fill and a toggle's on box (default `#00a800`)                       |
| `style.panel`         | `object`                                                       | no       |         |                                                 | the nine-slice frame panels, menus and dialogs are drawn in                     |
| `style.panel.sheet`   | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                       | a sprite file of the game                                                       |
| `style.panel.frame`   | `string`                                                       | yes      |         | not empty                                       | a frame of that sheet                                                           |
| `style.panel.palette` | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | a palette file to recolour it with                                              |
| `style.panel.slice`   | `integer \| object`                                            | yes      |         |                                                 | the corner insets in px: one number or `{ left, top, right, bottom }`           |
| `style.cursor`        | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty; length &lt;= 1                       | a character drawn left of the focused item (`>`)                                |
| `style.padding`       | `integer`                                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | px inside a panel (default 4)                                                   |
| `style.gap`           | `integer`                                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | px between menu items (default 2)                                               |
| `style.rate`          | `number`                                                       | no       |         | >= 0                                            | display frames per character a dialog types (default 2; 0 shows a page at once) |
| `style.typeEvery`     | `integer`                                                      | no       |         | >= 1                                            | characters per `type` sound (default 3)                                         |
| `style.sounds`        | `object`                                                       | no       |         |                                                 | sfx ids played by the shell on UI events (each optional)                        |
| `style.sounds.move`   | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | focus moved or a value changed                                                  |
| `style.sounds.select` | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | an item or a choice taken                                                       |
| `style.sounds.back`   | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | back out of a widget                                                            |
| `style.sounds.type`   | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | a dialog typing (every `typeEvery` characters)                                  |
| `style.sounds.page`   | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | a dialog turning to its next page                                               |
| `style.focusTween`    | `object \| object \| (object \| object)[]`                     | no       |         |                                                 | played on an item when it takes the focus (T1 tween specs)                      |
| `style.pressTween`    | `object \| object \| (object \| object)[]`                     | no       |         |                                                 | played on an item when it is pressed                                            |
| `focus`               | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | the widget id focused first (the first menu, dialog or button)                  |
| `back`                | `string`                                                       | no       |         | not empty                                       | the sfx played when `back` leaves the screen itself                             |
| `widgets`             | `(object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object)[]` | yes      |         | at least 1 item                                 | drawn in order, later ones on top                                               |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/ui.json`):

```json
{
  "style": {
    "font": "small",
    "shadow": "#000000",
    "panel": { "sheet": "ui", "frame": "panel", "slice": 2 },
    "cursor": ">",
    "sounds": { "move": "ui-move", "select": "ui-select", "back": "ui-back", "type": "ui-type" },
    "focusTween": { "prop": "x", "from": 4, "to": 0, "frames": 8, "ease": "backOut" }
  },
  "focus": "main",
  "widgets": [
    { "type": "panel", "anchor": "center", "color": "#000000", "alpha": 0.5, "w": 256, "h": 240 },
    { "type": "text", "anchor": "top", "y": 40, "text": "Paused", "font": "title", "outline": "#000000" },
    {
      "id": "main",
      "type": "menu",
      "anchor": "center",
      "items": [
        { "id": "resume", "label": "Resume" },
        { "id": "talk", "label": "Talk", "opens": "talk" },
        { "type": "slider", "id": "volume", "label": "Volume", "min": 0, "max": 10, "value": 7 },
        { "type": "toggle", "id": "shake", "label": "Screen shake", "value": true },
        { "id": "credits", "label": "Credits", "disabled": true }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "talk",
      "type": "dialog",
      "hidden": true,
      "speaker": "Pip",
      "portrait": { "sheet": "faces", "frame": "pip" },
      "pages": ["Hi! The door glows again tonight.", "Shall we go?"],
      "choices": [
        { "id": "yes", "label": "Let's go!" },
        { "id": "later", "label": "Not yet", "next": "main" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `level`

A platformer level: id, physics profile, scroll mode, spawns and bump-block contents, with its map in a text grid of the kit legend.

- Defined by: kit platformer
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.level`
- Read from: `.json` + `.map.txt`

| Field                 | Type                          | Required | Default   | Limits                                                                           | Description                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                  | `string`                      | yes      |           | not empty                                                                        | the level id: its file name                                                                                                           |
| `profile`             | `string`                      | yes      |           | not empty                                                                        | the physics profile it is played with: a `profile` id                                                                                 |
| `scroll`              | `"right" \| "free" \| "none"` | no       | `"right"` |                                                                                  | `right`: the camera only scrolls forward; `free`: both ways; `none`: it never scrolls                                                 |
| `size`                | `[integer, integer]`          | no       |           |                                                                                  | [columns, rows]; the size comes from the grid, and a size given here must match it                                                    |
| `spawns`              | `{ <key>: object }`           | no       | `{}`      |                                                                                  | spawn characters of the map (one character, not a legend one) by the actor they spawn                                                 |
| `spawns.<key>.actor`  | `string`                      | yes      |           | not empty                                                                        | the actor type it spawns, defined in the level's profile                                                                              |
| `spawns.<key>.facing` | `"left" \| "right"`           | no       | `"left"`  |                                                                                  | the way it starts moving                                                                                                              |
| `blocks`              | `string[]`                    | no       |           | items: matches `^(coin\|coins\|powerup\|life\|actor:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)$`           | what each bump block (?) holds, in reading order: coin, coins, powerup, life or actor:&lt;type>; all coins when left out              |
| `triggers`            | `object[]`                    | no       | `[]`      |                                                                                  | what each mini-game trigger (!) starts, in reading order: the mini game id, its params and the outcome of each result                 |
| `triggers[].game`     | `string`                      | yes      |           | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                                                   | the id of the mini game it starts, one the game supplies                                                                              |
| `triggers[].params`   | `{ <key>: JSON }`             | no       | `{}`      |                                                                                  | data for the mini game's round (its MiniGameContext.params)                                                                           |
| `triggers[].pass`     | `string[]`                    | no       | `[]`      | items: matches `^(coins:[1-9][0-9]*\|life\|clear\|respawn\|open:[0-9]+:[0-9]+)$` | what a pass does, in order: coins:&lt;n>, life, clear, respawn (on the trigger) or open:&lt;col>:&lt;row>; nothing when left out      |
| `triggers[].fail`     | `string[]`                    | no       | `[]`      | items: matches `^(coins:[1-9][0-9]*\|life\|clear\|respawn\|open:[0-9]+:[0-9]+)$` | what a fail does, in order: coins:&lt;n>, life, clear, respawn (on the trigger) or open:&lt;col>:&lt;row>; nothing when left out      |
| `triggers[].quit`     | `string[]`                    | no       | `[]`      | items: matches `^(coins:[1-9][0-9]*\|life\|clear\|respawn\|open:[0-9]+:[0-9]+)$` | what a quit does, in order: coins:&lt;n>, life, clear, respawn (on the trigger) or open:&lt;col>:&lt;row>; nothing when left out      |
| `triggers[].look`     | `string`                      | no       |           | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                                                   | how it looks (Engine 0.11, gap G13): presented as the tag `look:<id>` on the trigger's entity, for a skin's `byTag`; left out, no tag |
| `map`                 | `string[]`                    | yes      |           |                                                                                  | the level grid, top row first, of legend and spawn characters; usually in the `.map.txt` file                                         |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/level.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "tiny",
  "profile": "runner",
  "scroll": "right",
  "size": [24, 8],
  "spawns": { "w": { "actor": "walker" } },
  "blocks": ["coin"]
}
```

With `docs/reference/examples/level.map.txt`:

```text
........................
........................
........................
.......?................
........................
..................o.....
.@.............w.##...G.
##########...###########
```

### `profile`

A platformer physics profile: player movement numbers and actor types in whole sub-pixel and 1/4096 px per tick units.

- Defined by: kit platformer
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.profile`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                        | Type                  | Required | Default | Limits                            | Description                                                                                            |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                         | `string`              | yes      |         | not empty                         | the profile id: its file name (`runner.profile.json` is `runner`)                                      |
| `player`                     | `object`              | yes      |         |                                   | the player's movement numbers                                                                          |
| `player.box`                 | `object`              | yes      |         |                                   | the player's hit box in px                                                                             |
| `player.box.w`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | width in px                                                                                            |
| `player.box.h`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | height in px                                                                                           |
| `player.minWalk`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the speed a walk from rest starts at, in 1/4096 px per tick                                            |
| `player.walkAccel`           | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | acceleration while walking, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                           |
| `player.runAccel`            | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | acceleration while running, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                           |
| `player.friction`            | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | deceleration with no direction held, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                  |
| `player.skid`                | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | deceleration while holding the way opposite to the motion (a skid), in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick   |
| `player.skidTurn`            | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | below this speed a skid turns the player round at once, in 1/4096 px per tick                          |
| `player.maxWalk`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the walking speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                           |
| `player.maxRun`              | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the running speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                           |
| `player.runHold`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | ticks the running cap lasts after run is let go                                                        |
| `player.jumps`               | `object[]`            | yes      |         | at least 1 item                   | jump tiers by take-off speed, slowest first: the first whose `below` \|vx\| is under                   |
| `player.jumps[].below`       | `integer`             | no       |         | >= 1                              | the \|vx\| at take-off this tier applies below (left out on the last tier), in 1/4096 px per tick      |
| `player.jumps[].speed`       | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the take-off speed upwards, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                      |
| `player.jumps[].holdGravity` | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | gravity while jump is held and the player still rises, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                |
| `player.jumps[].gravity`     | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | gravity otherwise, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                                    |
| `player.jumpBuffer`          | `integer`             | no       |         | 0 to 30                           | ticks a jump press is remembered until the player can jump (0 when left out)                           |
| `player.maxFall`             | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the fall speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                              |
| `player.fallReset`           | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the fall speed set when a fall goes over `maxFall`, in 1/4096 px per tick                              |
| `player.stompBounce`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the upward speed a stomp bounces the player with, in 1/4096 px per tick                                |
| `player.hp`                  | `integer`             | no       | `1`     | 1 to 99                           | the hit points (power level) the player starts with; a harm takes one, at 0 it dies                    |
| `player.maxHp`               | `integer`             | no       |         | 1 to 99                           | the most hit points a power-up can raise it to (`hp` when left out)                                    |
| `player.invulnTicks`         | `integer`             | no       | `0`     | >= 0                              | ticks after a harm in which the player cannot be harmed again                                          |
| `player.breakBricksAt`       | `integer`             | no       |         | >= 1                              | from this many hit points up a head bump breaks a brick; left out, bricks never break                  |
| `player.lives`               | `integer`             | no       | `1`     | 1 to 99                           | tries at the level: a death with a life left respawns the player at the start                          |
| `actorGravity`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | gravity on every actor, in 1/4096 px per tick, each tick                                               |
| `actorMaxFall`               | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | every actor's fall speed cap, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                    |
| `actors`                     | `{ <key>: object }`   | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` | actor types by generic name (`walker`, `shell`): lower-case letters, digits and "-"                    |
| `actors.<key>.box`           | `object`              | no       |         |                                   | the hit box in px (16x16 when left out)                                                                |
| `actors.<key>.box.w`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | width in px                                                                                            |
| `actors.<key>.box.h`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | 1 to 64                           | height in px                                                                                           |
| `actors.<key>.speed`         | `integer`             | yes      |         | >= 0                              | walking speed; 0 stands still, in 1/4096 px per tick                                                   |
| `actors.<key>.turnAt`        | `"walls" \| "ledges"` | yes      |         |                                   | `walls`: turns round at a wall; `ledges`: also at the edge of a drop                                   |
| `actors.<key>.stompable`     | `boolean`             | yes      |         |                                   | a stomp from above beats it (and bounces the player)                                                   |
| `actors.<key>.stompInto`     | `string`              | no       |         | not empty                         | the actor type a stomp turns it into; left out, a stomp defeats it                                     |
| `actors.<key>.kickable`      | `boolean`             | yes      |         |                                   | touching it while it stands still kicks it away                                                        |
| `actors.<key>.kickSpeed`     | `integer`             | no       |         | >= 0                              | the speed a kick sends it at; required when kickable, in 1/4096 px per tick                            |
| `actors.<key>.harms`         | `boolean`             | yes      |         |                                   | touching it (other than a stomp or a kick) harms the player                                            |
| `actors.<key>.kickGrace`     | `integer`             | no       |         | 0 to 120                          | ticks after a kick (or a stomp that makes it) in which it does not touch the player (15 when left out) |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/profile.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "runner",
  "player": {
    "box": { "w": 12, "h": 16 },
    "minWalk": 304,
    "walkAccel": 152,
    "runAccel": 228,
    "friction": 208,
    "skid": 416,
    "skidTurn": 2304,
    "maxWalk": 6400,
    "maxRun": 10496,
    "runHold": 10,
    "jumps": [
      { "below": 4096, "speed": 16384, "holdGravity": 512, "gravity": 1792 },
      { "below": 9472, "speed": 16384, "holdGravity": 480, "gravity": 1536 },
      { "speed": 20480, "holdGravity": 640, "gravity": 2304 }
    ],
    "jumpBuffer": 4,
    "maxFall": 18432,
    "fallReset": 16384,
    "stompBounce": 16384,
    "hp": 2,
    "maxHp": 2,
    "invulnTicks": 150,
    "breakBricksAt": 2,
    "lives": 3
  },
  "actorGravity": 1024,
  "actorMaxFall": 16384,
  "actors": {
    "walker": { "speed": 2048, "turnAt": "walls", "stompable": true, "kickable": false, "harms": true },
    "shell-walker": {
      "box": { "w": 16, "h": 24 },
      "speed": 2048,
      "turnAt": "walls",
      "stompable": true,
      "stompInto": "shell",
      "kickable": false,
      "harms": true
    },
    "shell": {
      "speed": 0,
      "turnAt": "walls",
      "stompable": true,
      "stompInto": "shell",
      "kickable": true,
      "kickSpeed": 12288,
      "harms": true
    }
  }
}
```

### `rts-map`

An RTS map: a world scenario with the rts system set (terrain text grids, units, buildings, resource nodes).

- Defined by: kit rts
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.rts-map`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                             | Type                                                       | Required | Default | Limits                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`                          | `"worlds-within/scenario"`                                 | yes      |         |                                                            | always `worlds-within/scenario`                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `version`                         | `1`                                                        | yes      |         |                                                            | the scenario format version                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `seed`                            | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         |                                                            | the world's seed                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `systems`                         | `"rts"`                                                    | yes      |         |                                                            | always `rts`: the RTS units and economy                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `terrain`                         | `object`                                                   | yes      |         |                                                            | the terrain grid                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `terrain.legend`                  | `{ <key>: object }`                                        | yes      |         | keys: not empty; length &lt;= 1                            | one ground type per grid character                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.name`       | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the ground type name                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.cost`       | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 1                                                       | ticks to enter a cell of this type                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.passable`   | `boolean`                                                  | yes      |         |                                                            | false: nothing can enter it                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `terrain.rows`                    | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty                          | the grid, one string per row, north first                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `terrain.elevation`               | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | items: matches `^[0-9]+$`                                  | one elevation digit (0-9) per cell, the same size as `rows`                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `entities`                        | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | units, buildings, resource nodes, stockpiles and the types table, spawned in this order                                                                                                                                                     |
| `entities[].key`                  | `string`                                                   | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `entities[].components`           | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                          | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`                    | components by name, checked by the simulation when the world is built                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `squads`                          | `({ <key>: JSON })[]`                                      | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | squads with their named members (heroes), as in a world scenario                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `opportunities`                   | `({ <key>: JSON })[]`                                      | no       |         |                                                            | mission opportunities offered in the world (Engine 0.10), as in a world scenario: checked by the simulation when the world is built                                                                                                         |
| `from`                            | `object`                                                   | no       |         |                                                            | the scenario this map follows (Engine 0.13), as in a world scenario: what carries from that scenario's end world (people, stockpile items) and what a carried fate opens; checked against the map by the simulation when the world is built |
| `from.scenario`                   | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the first scenario's content id (the carried record's `from` must match)                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `from.carry`                      | `object`                                                   | yes      |         |                                                            | what carries (Engine 0.13)                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `from.carry.people`               | `string[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                  | the keys of named people (squad members) whose `Health` and fate carry; keys of both scenarios                                                                                                                                              |
| `from.carry.stockpiles`           | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | stockpile items by faction; the faction needs a `Stockpile` in both worlds                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `from.carry.stockpiles[].faction` | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | the faction whose stockpile's items carry                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `from.carry.stockpiles[].items`   | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the items whose counts carry (replacing the second scenario's)                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `from.when`                       | `object[]`                                                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                            | rules applied in order after the carried data: opportunities a carried fate opens                                                                                                                                                           |
| `from.when[].key`                 | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`                         | a key of `carry.people`                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `from.when[].fate`                | `"active" \| "injured" \| "captured" \| "freed" \| "dead"` | yes      |         |                                                            | the carried fate that triggers the rule                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `from.when[].open`                | `string[]`                                                 | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | dormant `relative` opportunities of this scenario to open at tick 0, in this order                                                                                                                                                          |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/rts-map.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/scenario",
  "version": 1,
  "seed": 9,
  "systems": "rts",
  "terrain": {
    "legend": {
      ".": { "name": "ground", "cost": 1, "passable": true },
      "#": { "name": "rock", "cost": 1, "passable": false }
    },
    "rows": ["........", "...##...", "........"],
    "elevation": ["00000000", "00000000", "00000000"]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "key": "types",
      "components": {
        "RtsTypes": {
          "units": {
            "worker": {
              "health": 20,
              "speed": 2,
              "attack": 1,
              "range": 1,
              "cooldown": 3,
              "sight": 4,
              "cost": { "gold": 50 },
              "trainTicks": 12,
              "work": 2,
              "gather": { "capacity": 3, "ticks": 2 }
            }
          },
          "buildings": {
            "hall": {
              "health": 400,
              "size": { "w": 2, "h": 2 },
              "work": 100,
              "dropoff": true,
              "trains": ["worker"]
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "key": "hall",
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0 },
        "Owner": { "faction": "red" },
        "Building": { "kind": "hall", "w": 2, "h": 2, "dropoff": true },
        "Health": { "hp": 400, "max": 400 },
        "Producer": { "trains": ["worker"], "queue": [], "progress": 0 },
        "Stockpile": { "faction": "red" },
        "Inventory": { "gold": 100 }
      }
    },
    {
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 7, "y": 0, "z": 0 },
        "Resource": { "item": "gold" },
        "Inventory": { "gold": 40 }
      }
    },
    {
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 2, "y": 2, "z": 0 },
        "Owner": { "faction": "red" },
        "Health": { "hp": 20, "max": 20 },
        "Unit": { "type": "worker", "speed": 2, "attack": 1, "range": 1, "cooldown": 3, "sight": 4 },
        "Worker": { "job": null, "rate": 2 },
        "Gatherer": { "capacity": 3, "ticks": 2, "node": null, "item": null, "carry": 0, "progress": 0 }
      }
    },
    {
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 6, "y": 2, "z": 0 },
        "Owner": { "faction": "blue" },
        "Health": { "hp": 20, "max": 20 },
        "Unit": { "type": "worker", "speed": 2, "attack": 1, "range": 1, "cooldown": 3, "sight": 4 }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### `rts-types`

RTS unit and building types: stats, costs, build and training times, what a building trains.

- Defined by: kit rts
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.rts-types`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                     | Type                 | Required | Default | Limits                                    | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `units`                   | `{ <key>: object }`  | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | unit types by id                                                                                            |
| `units.<key>.health`      | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | hit points of a new unit (Health.max)                                                                       |
| `units.<key>.speed`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks to cross one cell of cost 1 in a straight line                                                        |
| `units.<key>.attack`      | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                                      | damage per hit (0: it never hurts anything)                                                                 |
| `units.<key>.range`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | how far it hits, in whole cells                                                                             |
| `units.<key>.cooldown`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks from one hit to the next                                                                              |
| `units.<key>.sight`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                                      | how far it sees, in whole cells (for the view)                                                              |
| `units.<key>.cost`        | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `units.<key>.trainTicks`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks a building takes to train one                                                                         |
| `units.<key>.work`        | `integer \| null`    | no       | `null`  |                                           | construction work it adds per tick; only units with it can build                                            |
| `units.<key>.gather`      | `object \| null`     | no       | `null`  |                                           | { capacity, ticks }: it carries at most capacity, one item every ticks ticks; only units with it can gather |
| `buildings`               | `{ <key>: object }`  | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | building types by id                                                                                        |
| `buildings.<key>.health`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | hit points once built (Health.max)                                                                          |
| `buildings.<key>.size`    | `object`             | yes      |         |                                           | its footprint in cells, from its Position (the north-west cell)                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.size.w`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | width in cells, west to east                                                                                |
| `buildings.<key>.size.h`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | height in cells, north to south                                                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.work`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | construction work to finish it (build time: work / the workers' rates)                                      |
| `buildings.<key>.cost`    | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `buildings.<key>.trains`  | `string[]`           | no       | `[]`    | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the unit types it can train, once finished                                                                  |
| `buildings.<key>.dropoff` | `boolean`            | no       | `false` |                                           | whether gatherers can drop resources here, once finished                                                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/rts-types.json`):

```json
{
  "units": {
    "worker": {
      "health": 20,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 1,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 4,
      "sight": 5,
      "cost": { "gold": 50 },
      "trainTicks": 30,
      "work": 2,
      "gather": { "capacity": 5, "ticks": 4 }
    },
    "soldier": {
      "health": 40,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 5,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 6,
      "sight": 6,
      "cost": { "gold": 60 },
      "trainTicks": 45
    }
  },
  "buildings": {
    "hall": { "health": 600, "size": { "w": 3, "h": 3 }, "work": 300, "trains": ["worker"], "dropoff": true },
    "barracks": {
      "health": 300,
      "size": { "w": 2, "h": 2 },
      "work": 120,
      "cost": { "gold": 100 },
      "trains": ["soldier"]
    }
  }
}
```

### `rts-enemy`

A scripted enemy's plan: its faction and the orders it gives, at ticks or on triggers.

- Defined by: kit rts
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.rts-enemy`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                  | Type                                                       | Required | Default | Limits                             | Description                                          |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `faction`              | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the side the plan plays                              |
| `steps`                | `object[]`                                                 | yes      |         |                                    | tried in this order every tick                       |
| `steps[].id`           | `string`                                                   | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | names the step in the enemy state                    |
| `steps[].at`           | `integer`                                                  | no       | `0`     | >= 0                               | the first tick it may fire                           |
| `steps[].when`         | `object \| object`                                         | no       |         |                                    | it fires only once this holds                        |
| `steps[].repeat`       | `object`                                                   | no       |         |                                    | fire again every `every` ticks, `times` times in all |
| `steps[].repeat.every` | `integer`                                                  | yes      |         | >= 1                               | ticks between firings                                |
| `steps[].repeat.times` | `integer \| null`                                          | no       | `null`  |                                    | firings in all (null: for ever)                      |
| `steps[].order`        | `object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object` | yes      |         |                                    | the order to give, told apart by `type`              |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/rts-enemy.json`):

```json
{
  "faction": "blue",
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "rally",
      "order": { "type": "move", "units": { "idle": true }, "area": { "x": 4, "y": 0, "w": 3, "h": 3 } }
    },
    {
      "id": "train",
      "at": 20,
      "repeat": { "every": 60, "times": 4 },
      "order": { "type": "train", "building": "hall", "unit": "worker" }
    },
    {
      "id": "attack",
      "when": { "count": "units", "side": "self", "type": "worker", "op": "gte", "value": 3 },
      "order": { "type": "attack", "units": { "type": "worker" }, "target": "nearest-enemy" }
    }
  ]
}
```

### `room`

A top-down room: id, map cell, music, chests and an 11x16 map grid of the kit legend.

- Defined by: kit topdown
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.room`
- Read from: `.json` + `.map.txt`

| Field               | Type                                             | Required | Default | Limits           | Description                                                                         |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                | `string`                                         | yes      |         | not empty        | the room id: its file name                                                          |
| `at`                | `[integer, integer]`                             | yes      |         |                  | the room's cell on the dungeon map, [column, row]; neighbours share an edge         |
| `map`               | `string[]`                                       | yes      |         |                  | 11 rows of 16 kit legend characters; usually in the sibling `.map.txt` file         |
| `shutters`          | `"clear" \| "plates" \| "switches" \| "torches"` | no       |         |                  | what opens the room's shutter doors (X)                                             |
| `reveal`            | `"clear" \| "plates" \| "switches" \| "torches"` | no       |         |                  | what makes the room's hidden pickups appear                                         |
| `music`             | `string`                                         | no       |         | not empty        | the song id played in the room (else the game's)                                    |
| `hint`              | `string`                                         | no       |         | not empty        | read to screen readers when the room is first entered                               |
| `title`             | `string`                                         | no       |         | not empty        | a title to show for the room: a room challenge's (the mini game's) title            |
| `dark`              | `boolean`                                        | no       |         |                  | a free flag a game may use (a darker palette)                                       |
| `goal`              | `boolean`                                        | no       |         |                  | the room the compass points to                                                      |
| `chests`            | `string[]`                                       | no       |         | items: not empty | what each chest (c) holds, in reading order: an item id or a pickup kind            |
| `wall`              | `integer`                                        | no       |         | 0 to 3           | the outer wall's thickness in tiles, over the dungeon's; 0 is an outdoor screen     |
| `art`               | `(string[] \| null)[]`                           | no       |         |                  | each cell's tile-sheet frames, bottom to top, in reading order; null draws its tile |
| `entrances`         | `object[]`                                       | no       |         |                  | building doors inside the room                                                      |
| `entrances[].id`    | `string`                                         | yes      |         | not empty        | the door id, unique in the dungeon                                                  |
| `entrances[].col`   | `integer`                                        | yes      |         |                  | the door cell's column                                                              |
| `entrances[].row`   | `integer`                                        | yes      |         |                  | the door cell's row                                                                 |
| `entrances[].enter` | `"up" \| "down" \| "left" \| "right"`            | yes      |         |                  | the way the hero walks to go in                                                     |
| `entrances[].to`    | `string`                                         | yes      |         | not empty        | the paired door's id, or "@&lt;action>" for the game to handle                      |
| `entrances[].needs` | `string`                                         | no       |         | not empty        | a secret that must be found before it opens                                         |
| `entrances[].shut`  | `boolean`                                        | no       |         |                  | starts closed until its secret is found                                             |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/room.json`):

```json
{ "id": "hall", "at": [0, 0], "music": "theme", "chests": ["bombs"] }
```

With `docs/reference/examples/room.map.txt`:

```text
################
#..............#
#..t........t..#
#..............#
#......c.......#
#.......@......#
#..............#
#..............#
#..............#
#..............#
################
```

### `td-map`

A tower-defense map: starting gold and lives, the tower types and wave list it plays, with its grid (path from entry to exit, build cells, blocked ground) in a text grid.

- Defined by: kit towerdefense
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.td-map`
- Read from: `.json` + `.map.txt`

| Field         | Type                                                             | Required | Default | Limits                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`          | `string`                                                         | yes      |         | not empty                                              | the map id: its file name                                                                                                                                                 |
| `title`       | `string`                                                         | no       |         | not empty                                              | one line naming the map, for a page or HUD                                                                                                                                |
| `legend`      | `{ <key>: "blocked" \| "path" \| "build" \| "entry" \| "exit" }` | no       | `{}`    |                                                        | the map's own grid characters (one character each, not a kit legend one) by the cell kind they mean: blocked, path, build, entry or exit                                  |
| `start`       | `object`                                                         | yes      |         |                                                        | what the round starts with                                                                                                                                                |
| `start.gold`  | `integer`                                                        | yes      |         | >= 0                                                   | the gold the round starts with, to pay for towers                                                                                                                         |
| `start.lives` | `integer`                                                        | yes      |         | >= 1                                                   | the lives the round starts with; a leak costs one                                                                                                                         |
| `towers`      | `string[]`                                                       | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | the tower types that can be placed on this map, by `td-towers` id, in button order                                                                                        |
| `waves`       | `string`                                                         | no       |         | not empty                                              | the wave list a standalone round plays: a `td-waves` file name; left out only on a map used by `td-defence` missions alone, whose wave is the world's units (Engine 0.15) |
| `map`         | `string[]`                                                       | yes      |         |                                                        | the grid, top row first, of legend characters; usually in the `.map.txt` file                                                                                             |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/td-map.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "meadow",
  "title": "The meadow road",
  "legend": { "W": "build" },
  "start": { "gold": 50, "lives": 5 },
  "towers": ["arrow", "cannon"],
  "waves": "meadow"
}
```

With `docs/reference/examples/td-map.map.txt`:

```text
..B.....
S#####B.
.W...#..
..X###W.
........
```

### `td-towers`

Tower-defense tower types: cost, range in cells, damage, cooldown in ticks and sell value.

- Defined by: kit towerdefense
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.td-towers`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                   | Type                | Required | Default | Limits                               | Description                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `towers`                | `{ <key>: object }` | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | tower types by id                                                                                |
| `towers.<key>.cost`     | `integer`           | yes      |         | >= 0                                 | the gold placing one costs                                                                       |
| `towers.<key>.range`    | `integer`           | yes      |         | >= 0                                 | how far it reaches, in cells: an enemy whose cell is within this distance (squared, whole cells) |
| `towers.<key>.damage`   | `integer`           | yes      |         | >= 1                                 | the hit points one shot takes                                                                    |
| `towers.<key>.cooldown` | `integer`           | yes      |         | >= 1                                 | ticks from one shot to the next (1: every tick)                                                  |
| `towers.<key>.sell`     | `integer`           | no       |         | >= 0                                 | the gold selling one gives back; half its cost (rounded down) when left out                      |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/td-towers.json`):

```json
{
  "towers": {
    "arrow": { "cost": 10, "range": 2, "damage": 1, "cooldown": 6 },
    "cannon": { "cost": 30, "range": 3, "damage": 4, "cooldown": 20, "sell": 20 }
  }
}
```

### `td-waves`

A tower-defense wave list: waves of enemy groups (kind, count, spacing, hp, speed, bounty) and an optional timer.

- Defined by: kit towerdefense
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.td-waves`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                      | Type       | Required | Default | Limits                         | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                       | `string`   | yes      |         | not empty                      | the wave list id: its file name, which a map names in `waves`                                                                                     |
| `timer`                    | `integer`  | no       |         | >= 1                           | ticks after the round starts, or after the last wave started, at which the next wave starts by itself; left out, only the start button starts one |
| `waves`                    | `object[]` | yes      |         | at least 1 item                | the waves, in the order they come                                                                                                                 |
| `waves[].groups`           | `object[]` | yes      |         | at least 1 item                | the enemy groups, one after another in file order                                                                                                 |
| `waves[].groups[].kind`    | `string`   | yes      |         | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | the enemy kind, a name for skins and reports                                                                                                      |
| `waves[].groups[].count`   | `integer`  | yes      |         | >= 1                           | how many come                                                                                                                                     |
| `waves[].groups[].spacing` | `integer`  | yes      |         | >= 0                           | ticks from one enemy of the group to the next (0: all at once)                                                                                    |
| `waves[].groups[].hp`      | `integer`  | yes      |         | >= 1                           | hit points each has                                                                                                                               |
