| `waves[].groups[].speed`   | `integer`  | yes      |         | 1 to 16                        | sub-cell units walked each tick (16 to a cell, so at most one cell a tick)                                                                        |
| `waves[].groups[].bounty`  | `integer`  | yes      |         | >= 0                           | the gold a kill pays                                                                                                                              |
| `waves[].groups[].jitter`  | `integer`  | no       |         | >= 0                           | up to this many more ticks (drawn from the round RNG) added to each spacing; 0 when left out                                                      |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/td-waves.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "meadow",
  "timer": 600,
  "waves": [
    { "groups": [{ "kind": "scout", "count": 5, "spacing": 30, "hp": 3, "speed": 2, "bounty": 2 }] },
    {
      "groups": [
        { "kind": "scout", "count": 4, "spacing": 20, "hp": 3, "speed": 2, "bounty": 2, "jitter": 10 },
        { "kind": "brute", "count": 2, "spacing": 60, "hp": 12, "speed": 1, "bounty": 6 }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Kit options

A kit's own options, given in `game.json`'s `kitOptions` under the kit's name (gap G17);
`validate` checks them with the manifest.

### `topdown` kit options

How kit `topdown` treats this game (Engine 0.15, gap G17): read by its hook's `kinds(manifest)`; an option it does not have is `unknown_option`, a bad value `bad_option`.

- Defined by: kit topdown
- Where: `kitOptions.topdown` in a game's `game.json`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field   | Type                      | Required | Default | Limits | Description                                                                                                                                              |
| ------- | ------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rooms` | `"dungeon" \| "separate"` | no       |         |        | how the room files are checked: `dungeon` (the default) as one dungeon, `separate` each room alone (challenge or mission rooms, each with its own start) |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/topdown-options.json`):

```json
{ "rooms": "separate" }
```

## Mini game params

The params of a kit's mini games that content names by a fixed id (`KitDef.paramsDocs`);
`validate` checks them with the content (gap G16).

### `mission-room` params

A mission over a world played as one top-down room (Engine 0.11): a `*.mission.json`'s `params` when its `play` is `mission-room`. Which world entities become which foes in the room's slot cells, the round's goal and limits, and ordered rules from the round's report to the mission's declared outcomes.

- Defined by: kit topdown
- Where: the `params` of a `*.mission.json` whose `play` is `mission-room`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                          | Type                               | Required | Default | Limits                            | Description                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `room`                         | `string`                           | yes      |         | not empty                         | the id of the game's `room` file the round is played in                                                                                                                |
| `goal`                         | `"defeat-all" \| "reach"`          | yes      |         |                                   | what the round asks: every foe beaten, or an exit tile reached                                                                                                         |
| `ticks`                        | `integer`                          | no       |         | >= 1                              | the round's time limit in ticks (1800 when left out)                                                                                                                   |
| `hp`                           | `integer`                          | no       |         | >= 1                              | the hero's hit points in half hearts (the kit's default when left out); not with `hero`                                                                                |
| `hero`                         | `object`                           | no       |         |                                   | the world unit the room's hero is, whose hp goes into the round and back (Engine 0.13)                                                                                 |
| `hero.select`                  | `object`                           | yes      |         |                                   | which world unit the hero is: exactly one living one, never captured or dead (`event` is any event when left out, not the mission's)                                   |
| `hero.select.event`            | `string`                           | no       |         | not empty                         | members of this event (`EventMember`); the mission's `event` when left out                                                                                             |
| `hero.select.faction`          | `string`                           | no       |         | not empty                         | only entities of this faction (`Owner`)                                                                                                                                |
| `hero.select.types`            | `string[]`                         | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty | only units of these types (`Unit.type`)                                                                                                                                |
| `hero.select.member`           | `"regular" \| "hero" \| "captain"` | no       |         |                                   | only named squad members with this role (`Member.role`)                                                                                                                |
| `hero.select.squad`            | `string \| integer`                | no       |         |                                   | only named members of this squad (`Member.squad`), named by its scenario key or entity id (Engine 0.15)                                                                |
| `hero.hpPer`                   | `integer`                          | yes      |         | >= 1                              | world hit points per half heart: the hero starts on `Health.hp / hpPer` (rounded up, at least 1), and each half heart lost costs `hpPer` world hp (never the last one) |
| `foes`                         | `object[]`                         | yes      |         | at least 1 item                   | which world entities become which foes, in which slots                                                                                                                 |
| `foes[].slot`                  | `string`                           | yes      |         | not empty; length &lt;= 1         | the room's map character whose cells, in reading order, these foes stand on                                                                                            |
| `foes[].kind`                  | `string`                           | yes      |         | not empty                         | the enemy kind they are in the room (`knight`, or a game spawn kind)                                                                                                   |
| `foes[].select`                | `object`                           | no       | `{}`    |                                   | which world entities become these foes                                                                                                                                 |
| `foes[].select.event`          | `string`                           | no       |         | not empty                         | members of this event (`EventMember`); the mission's `event` when left out                                                                                             |
| `foes[].select.faction`        | `string`                           | no       |         | not empty                         | only entities of this faction (`Owner`)                                                                                                                                |
| `foes[].select.types`          | `string[]`                         | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty | only units of these types (`Unit.type`)                                                                                                                                |
| `foes[].select.member`         | `"regular" \| "hero" \| "captain"` | no       |         |                                   | only named squad members with this role (`Member.role`)                                                                                                                |
| `foes[].select.squad`          | `string \| integer`                | no       |         |                                   | only named members of this squad (`Member.squad`), named by its scenario key or entity id (Engine 0.15)                                                                |
| `foes[].hpPer`                 | `integer`                          | no       |         | >= 1                              | world hit points per room hit point (rounded up, at least 1); the kind's own hp when left out                                                                          |
| `outcomes`                     | `object[]`                         | yes      |         | at least 1 item                   | rules from the round to a declared outcome, tried in order; the first that holds wins                                                                                  |
| `outcomes[].outcome`           | `string`                           | yes      |         | not empty                         | the mission's declared outcome this rule gives                                                                                                                         |
| `outcomes[].when`              | `object`                           | no       |         |                                   | what must all hold (left out: always; the last rule must have none)                                                                                                    |
| `outcomes[].when.result`       | `"pass" \| "fail"`                 | no       |         |                                   | how the round ended: its goal met (`pass`) or not (`fail`)                                                                                                             |
| `outcomes[].when.destroyed`    | `(string \| integer)[]`            | no       |         | at least 1 item                   | world entities (scenario keys or ids) that were all destroyed in the round                                                                                             |
| `outcomes[].when.spared`       | `(string \| integer)[]`            | no       |         | at least 1 item                   | world entities (scenario keys or ids) none of which was destroyed                                                                                                      |
| `outcomes[].when.minDestroyed` | `integer`                          | no       |         | >= 0                              | at least this many foes destroyed                                                                                                                                      |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/mission-room-params.json`):

```json
{
  "room": "siege-camp",
  "goal": "defeat-all",
  "ticks": 1800,
  "hp": 6,
  "foes": [
    {
      "slot": "E",
      "kind": "knight",
      "select": { "faction": "raiders", "types": ["ram", "catapult"] },
      "hpPer": 20
    },
    { "slot": "n", "kind": "bat", "select": { "faction": "raiders", "member": "regular" } }
  ],
  "outcomes": [
    { "outcome": "both-burnt", "when": { "destroyed": ["ram", "catapult"] } },
    { "outcome": "ram-burnt", "when": { "destroyed": ["ram"] } },
    { "outcome": "catapult-burnt", "when": { "destroyed": ["catapult"] } },
    { "outcome": "driven-off" }
  ]
}
```

### `td-defence` params

A mission over a world played as one tower-defense round (Engine 0.12): a `*.mission.json`'s `params` when its `play` is `td-defence`. The map, which world entities (walls) stand on its build cells, where the gold comes from, the lives, which world units come as the wave, and ordered rules from the round's report to the mission's declared outcomes.

- Defined by: kit towerdefense
- Where: the `params` of a `*.mission.json` whose `play` is `td-defence`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                         | Type                    | Required | Default | Limits                            | Description                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `map`                         | `string`                | yes      |         | not empty                         | the id of the game's `td-map` the round is played on                                                         |
| `build`                       | `object`                | no       |         |                                   | which world entities (walls) stand on the map's build cells; the map's own cells when left out               |
| `build.select`                | `object`                | yes      |         |                                   | which world entities (the walls) stand on the build cells                                                    |
| `build.select.event`          | `string`                | no       |         | not empty                         | only members of this event (`EventMember`); for `wave` the mission's `event` when left out, for `build` any  |
| `build.select.faction`        | `string`                | no       |         | not empty                         | only entities of this faction (`Owner`)                                                                      |
| `build.select.types`          | `string[]`              | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty | only units (`Unit.type`) or buildings (`Building.kind`) of these types                                       |
| `build.select.keys`           | `(string \| integer)[]` | no       |         | at least 1 item                   | only entities with these world names (the mission's scenario keys, or ids)                                   |
| `build.slot`                  | `string`                | no       |         | not empty; length &lt;= 1         | the map character (a build cell's) whose cells the walls stand on; every build cell when left out            |
| `build.cells`                 | `object[]`              | no       |         | at least 1 item                   | walls put on named build cells (Engine 0.15, lesson D10); the rest fill the remaining cells in the old order |
| `build.cells[].entity`        | `string \| integer`     | yes      |         |                                   | the wall, by world name (scenario key) or id; one `select` picks                                             |
| `build.cells[].cell`          | `object`                | yes      |         |                                   | the build cell it stands on                                                                                  |
| `build.cells[].cell.x`        | `integer`               | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the build cell's column on the map                                                                           |
| `build.cells[].cell.y`        | `integer`               | yes      |         | >= 0                              | the build cell's row on the map                                                                              |
| `budget`                      | `object`                | no       |         |                                   | where the round's gold comes from; the map's `start.gold` when left out                                      |
| `budget.faction`              | `string`                | yes      |         | not empty                         | the faction whose stockpile pays (the entity with its `Stockpile`)                                           |
| `budget.item`                 | `string`                | yes      |         | not empty                         | the stockpile item that is the gold (`Inventory.<item>`)                                                     |
| `budget.cap`                  | `integer`               | no       |         | >= 0                              | at most this much of it goes to the round                                                                    |
| `lives`                       | `integer`               | no       |         | >= 1                              | the round's lives; the map's `start.lives` when left out                                                     |
| `timer`                       | `integer`               | no       |         | >= 1                              | ticks after which the wave starts by itself; left out, only the start button starts it                       |
| `wave`                        | `object[]`              | yes      |         | at least 1 item                   | which world units come down the path, in this order                                                          |
| `wave[].kind`                 | `string`                | yes      |         | not empty                         | the enemy kind they are in the round (for skins and reports)                                                 |
| `wave[].select`               | `object`                | no       | `{}`    |                                   | which world units become these enemies                                                                       |
| `wave[].select.event`         | `string`                | no       |         | not empty                         | only members of this event (`EventMember`); for `wave` the mission's `event` when left out, for `build` any  |
| `wave[].select.faction`       | `string`                | no       |         | not empty                         | only entities of this faction (`Owner`)                                                                      |
| `wave[].select.types`         | `string[]`              | no       |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty | only units (`Unit.type`) or buildings (`Building.kind`) of these types                                       |
| `wave[].select.keys`          | `(string \| integer)[]` | no       |         | at least 1 item                   | only entities with these world names (the mission's scenario keys, or ids)                                   |
| `wave[].hpPer`                | `integer`               | no       |         | >= 1                              | world hit points per round hit point (rounded up, at least 1); `Health.hp` when left out                     |
| `wave[].speed`                | `integer`               | yes      |         | 1 to 16                           | sub-cell units walked each tick (16 to a cell)                                                               |
| `wave[].spacing`              | `integer`               | no       | `0`     | >= 0                              | ticks from one of them entering to the next                                                                  |
| `wave[].bounty`               | `integer`               | no       | `0`     | >= 0                              | the gold a kill pays in the round                                                                            |
| `outcomes`                    | `object[]`              | yes      |         | at least 1 item                   | rules from the round to a declared outcome, tried in order; the first that holds wins                        |
| `outcomes[].outcome`          | `string`                | yes      |         | not empty                         | the mission's declared outcome this rule gives                                                               |
| `outcomes[].when`             | `object`                | no       |         |                                   | what must all hold (left out: always; the last rule must have none)                                          |
| `outcomes[].when.result`      | `"pass" \| "fail"`      | no       |         |                                   | how the round ended: every enemy dealt with and lives left (`pass`), or no lives left (`fail`)               |
| `outcomes[].when.leaksAtMost` | `integer`               | no       |         | >= 0                              | at most this many enemies reached the exit                                                                   |
| `outcomes[].when.spentAtMost` | `integer`               | no       |         | >= 0                              | at most this much gold spent on towers, net of what selling gave back                                        |
| `outcomes[].when.killed`      | `(string \| integer)[]` | no       |         | at least 1 item                   | world units (scenario keys or ids) that were all killed in the round                                         |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/td-defence-params.json`):

```json
{
  "map": "wall-road",
  "lives": 3,
  "timer": 200,
  "build": { "select": { "faction": "village", "types": ["wall"] }, "slot": "W" },
  "budget": { "faction": "village", "item": "gold", "cap": 60 },
  "wave": [
    {
      "kind": "raider",
      "select": { "faction": "raiders", "types": ["raider"] },
      "hpPer": 10,
      "speed": 4,
      "spacing": 8,
      "bounty": 2
    }
  ],
  "outcomes": [
    { "outcome": "held-cheap", "when": { "leaksAtMost": 0, "spentAtMost": 20 } },
    { "outcome": "held", "when": { "leaksAtMost": 0 } },
    { "outcome": "captain-slain", "when": { "killed": ["captain"] } },
    { "outcome": "breached" }
  ]
}
```

### Mini games a game defines

A game's own mini games (`HeadlessEntry.miniGames`, such as a room challenge whose id is
its room's) each have a params page of their own (gap M11):

- [`cellar` (platformer)](mini-games/platformer-cellar.md): CELLAR
- [`stop-bar` (platformer-lab)](mini-games/platformer-lab-stop-bar.md): STOP THE BAR
- [`vault` (platformer)](mini-games/platformer-vault.md): VAULT
